title: AI & Automation Engineer

title: SCADA Specialist (Design & Installation)
job_description:
1. Position Summary

The SCADA Specialist is responsible for designing, configuring, installing, and commissioning SCADA and automation systems for industrial facilities including fuel storage tanks, jetty operations, workshops, and weighbridge systems. The role requires strong hands-on experience in PLC programming, instrumentation, data communication, and SCADA integration.

⸻

2. Key Responsibilities

A. SCADA & Automation System Design

Develop SCADA architecture, control philosophies, and automation workflow diagrams.

Design HMI/SCADA screens for real-time monitoring, alarms, trends, and control logic.

Prepare IO list, control panel drawings, and interface diagrams.

Configure PLC/RTU/SCADA systems for:

Fuel storage tanks (level, pressure, temperature, ESD, ATG integration)

Jetty automation (pumps, valves, loading arms, emergency cut-off)

Workshops (compressors, cranes, power systems monitoring)

Weighbridge systems (load cells, sensors, RFID/OCR integration)

B. Installation & Commissioning

Lead installation of automation panels, sensors, field instruments, and control wiring.

Perform programming, FAT, SAT, and commissioning of SCADA/PLC systems.

Integrate communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, OPC, and RS-485.

Troubleshoot PLC, SCADA, and communication network issues on site.

C. Maintenance & Support

Provide ongoing support for SCADA systems, fault diagnosis, and system upgrades.

Maintain data logs, reporting systems, and alarm management.

Train site personnel on operating SCADA systems and automation equipment.

D. Documentation & Coordination

Prepare technical documents:

FDS (Functional Design Specification)

P&ID interface review

Test reports and commissioning records

As-built documentation

Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, and IT teams to ensure full integration.

Work closely with OEMs and vendors for calibration and instrumentation supply.

⸻

3. Qualifications

Diploma or Bachelors Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or equivalent.

Minimum 46 years experience in SCADA/PLC automation for industrial projects.

Strong knowledge in PLCs such as Siemens, Schneider, Allen-Bradley, Omron (any is acceptable).

Skilled in HMI/SCADA software (Ignition, Wonderware, WinCC, Citect, etc.).

Strong understanding of instrumentation for fuel tanks and jetty operations.

Experience integrating sensors for weighbridge and workshop machinery.

Familiar with P&ID, loop diagrams, I/O mapping, and industrial networking.

⸻

4. Preferred Experience

Fuel storage terminal automation

Jetty loading/unloading control systems

Workshop electrical and equipment monitoring

Weighbridge automation & data acquisition

Experience with EX-proof instrumentation (advantage)

AME Group is a leading provider of consulting and research services to the Metals & Mining and Energy industries. Drawing on more than 50 years of industry expertise, we deliver bespoke consulting engagements, subscription research, and software-as-a-service products to clients globally. 

Our Jakarta office houses a well-established team of approximately 30 staff and is one of the AME’s key global research hubs. From this office we deliver consulting services to clients across Indonesia and South East Asia, while contributing to AME's worldwide research output. 

About the Role 

We are seeking an experienced Commodities Director to lead the Jakarta research function, providing operational management, quality assurance, and quality control over the team's research output. 

Jakarta Research Analysts are primarily responsible for: 

Accurate capture of asset and company level information from a variety of public and proprietary sources. 

Producing regular commodity market research publications 

Contributing to consulting engagements for both Indonesian and international clients 

Execution of market balance, pricing and demand forecasting models 

A successful candidate would work closely with AME's global research commodity leads, CTO and Managing Director to ensure research output meets the quality standards required across the business. 

Key Responsibilities 

A successful Commodities Director will assure the quality of analyst research while providing feedback and development opportunities, to this end, the manager will be responsible for 

Overseeing the end-to-end production for data collection, modelling and report generation. Including prioritisation, assignment, tracking and completion of analysts' work. 

Work with software and data engineering team to develop dashboards and tracking tools. 

Check analysts' deliverables against defined standards (defined by product owners), including confirming consistency with AME’s methodologies. 

Provide structured QA and spot checks to analysts’ work, provide meaningful feedback and manage rework where required. 

Provide preventative guidance, such as identifying common mistakes and identifying opportunities for training, methodology or software improvements. 

Work closely with product owners to establish and measure KPIs for analysts. 

Qualification and Experience 

This role is in fundamental commodities research, analyzing physical commodity markets through supply and demand balances, pricing models, and site-level data. It is not a market research, consumer insights, or marketing analytics role. Candidates without direct experience in physical commodity markets analysis will not be progressed. 

Required 

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, or Commerce 

10+ years of experience in fundamental commodities research, gained at a financial institution (investment bank, credit desk, hedge fund, private equity, asset manager, or trading house), the economics function of a consulting firm, or a specialist commodities research company.

An entrepreneurial mindset, with a proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing research teams 

Highly Desirable 

Experience in finance, transactions, or corporate development within Mining, Energy, or Metals sectors 

Technical Skills 

Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience building and developing analyst teams 

Expertise in fundamental commodities analysis, supply and demand modelling, price forecasting, cost curve construction, and asset-level evaluation 

Demonstrated track record of producing written research and advisory output for clients (institutional investors, lenders, corporates, or government) 

Highly numerate, with advanced quantitative and analytical skills and strong attention to detail 

In depth knowledge of the global resources sector, with specialist expertise in at least one commodity (Coal or Nickel preferred)

title: Product Manager – Healthcare AI (Indonesia)
job_description:
About the Role

We're building AI agents that transform healthcare delivery — from clinical documentation to MCU workflows. We need a Product Manager who doesn't just write specs and wait. You prototype with AI yourself, understand what it can and can't do, and use that hands-on intuition to drive the right product decisions.

You'll be the critical link between commercial and engineering — making sure client promises become real, shippable products on a clear timeline. This is a cross-border role spanning China and Indonesia, so you'll need to communicate across languages, cultures, and functions with energy and clarity.

---

What You'll Do

Hands-on AI prototyping: Build quick prototypes and proof-of-concepts using AI tools yourself. Understand the capabilities and limitations of LLMs and AI agents firsthand — so you can make grounded product decisions, not theoretical ones.

Bridge commercial and engineering: Align what we sell with what we build. Translate client needs and commercial commitments into clear, prioritized product requirements — and hold both sides accountable to realistic timelines.

Own the timeline: Manage end-to-end delivery across multiple client projects. Set milestones, track dependencies, flag risks early, and drive on-time go-lives.

Go deep into healthcare workflows: Immerse yourself in clinical, MCU, SOAP, and BPJS processes. Find the pain points. Then design AI-powered solutions that actually solve them.

Be the communication engine: Proactively drive alignment across teams in Indonesia and China. You don't wait to be asked — you initiate, follow up, escalate, and close the loop. Daily.

Define product direction: Collect client feedback, regulatory requirements, and frontline insights. Turn them into User Stories and roadmap priorities that the engineering team can execute on.

---

Who You Are

Trilingual: Fluent in Mandarin, English, and Bahasa Indonesia. You move seamlessly between cultures and teams.

Hands-on with AI: You've actually used AI tools to build things — not just read about them. You know where AI shines and where it breaks.

A relentless communicator:** You're the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You over-communicate by design, not by accident.

Healthcare domain knowledge: Background in healthtech, clinical operations, or medical informatics. You understand real hospital workflows.

Experienced PM: 4+ years in product management. You know how to manage timelines, scope, trade-offs, and stakeholders under pressure.

Outgoing and high-energy: You build trust fast, thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable being the loudest voice in the room when alignment is needed.

Bachelor's degree or above** in a relevant field (CS, Engineering, Healthcare, Biomedical, or similar).

---

Nice to Have

- Experience with API integrations, EMR/SOAP standards, or BPJS workflows.

- Startup / scale-up experience — speed over perfection.

- Cross-country product team experience (especially China–Southeast Asia).

What We Provide

- Cutting-edge AI tools at your fingertips: We provide Claude Max, Codex, and other top-tier AI accounts so you can prototype, experiment, and build with the best tools available — no personal subscription needed.

- Real ownership in a high-growth, cross-border healthcare AI company.

- Direct impact: Your work shapes products used by real doctors and patients across Indonesia.

- Global exposure: Work daily with teams across China and Southeast Asia.

- A team that believes AI will reshape healthcare — and is actually building it.

---

Why Join Us

You'll be at the intersection of AI and healthcare in one of the world's largest markets. This isn't a "manage Jira tickets" PM role — you'll prototype AI solutions with your own hands, sit in clinics to find real problems, and ship products that change how millions of people receive care.

If you want to build the future of healthcare AI — not just talk about it — let's talk.

title: Consultant/Senior Consultant - Lean & Kaizen Transformation
job_description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a mid to senior-level consultant with hands-on Continuous Improvement (CI) experience to drive operational transformation across Southeast Asia.

This role is suited for individuals who have personally led and implemented improvement initiatives, delivering measurable results using Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma, or TPM methodologies.

You will work closely with senior leaders and frontline teams, structured and critical thinking, root cause problem-solving, and strong facilitation skills. The role demands the ability to operate in ambiguity and sustain impact over longer project cycles.

Location Note: This role is based in Jakarta. We also welcome Singapore based applicants.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Leadership & Implementation

Lead and execute client projects across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, construction, and services.

Diagnose operational issues through process mapping, KPI analysis, Gemba walks, and stakeholder interviews.

Design and implement Lean and Kaizen-based improvement strategies.

Facilitate VSM (Value Stream Mapping), problem-solving workshops, and Kaizen events.

Ensure successful delivery of measurable outcomes (e.g., lead time reduction, OEE improvement, cost savings).

2. Client Engagement & Coaching

Build trusted advisory relationships with client sponsors and stakeholders.

Coach leaders and teams in problem-solving, daily management, and continuous improvement routines.

Present findings, roadmaps, and recommendations to client senior management with clarity and confidence.

3. Training & Capability Building

Design and deliver engaging, contextualized training programs in Lean, Kaizen, TPM, and Six Sigma.

Support internal and client-side capability building through mentorship, train-the-trainer programs, and certification pathways.

4. Thought Leadership & Knowledge Development

Contribute to the development of training materials, toolkits, case studies, and methodologies.

Write articles or insights that build Kaizen Institute’s thought leadership in the region.

5. Internal Collaboration & Growth Support

Guide junior consultants and support onboarding of new hires.

Maintain clear records (timesheets, reports) and contribute to proposals, client pitches, and business development.

Assist with internal operations, especially where required for the Indonesia practice (e.g., HR/admin support).

 Skills & Competencies

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical thinker with practical problem-solving ability.

Self-driven, resilient, and results focused.

Enjoys engaging with people and driving cultural change.

Able to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail.

Soft Skills

Excellent facilitation, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Comfortable engaging both senior leadership and shopfloor teams.

Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (multilingual a plus).

Able to thrive in ambiguity and work independently.

Technical / Hard Skills

Project management experience with structured reporting and delivery.

Proficient in process analysis tools: VSM, A3, PDCA, RCA, standard work, etc.

Confident in developing executive-level slide decks and reports.

Visualization and workshop design (e.g., Miro, Lucidchart, PowerPoint).

Technical Tools

Must-have: PowerPoint, Excel, Word

Preferred: Minitab, Tableau/Power BI, Lucidchart/Visio, ThinkCell

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations, or Business Analytics; Master's preferred.

Certified in Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), TPM, or equivalent.

7–12 years of relevant experience, including:

Hands-on CI project implementation

Experience in consulting OR internal CI/OPEX roles

Experience across multiple industries preferred

Willingness to travel regionally for client engagements (typically 20–40%)

About Kaizen Institute

Kaizen Institute is a global leader in operational excellence and continuous improvement. With over 40 years of experience, we work with leading organizations to enhance productivity, drive transformation, and build high-performance cultures through Lean, TPM, and Kaizen™ methodologies.

We operate in more than 60 countries, serving clients across industries including manufacturing, healthcare, FMCG, logistics, pharmaceuticals, and construction. As we grow our footprint in Singapore and the broader Southeast Asia region, we are seeking a Consultant / Senior Consultant – Lean and Kaizen Transformation.


Our Approach to Hiring

We are building a high-caliber consulting team and maintain a selective hiring standard for this role. We focus on candidates with clear ownership of implementation and measurable impact, with a strong emphasis on long-term fit over speed.

Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or support-based, without hands-on implementation ownership, are unlikely to be a strong fit for this role.

The role of the Ops Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.

This role is designed to problem solve impactful operational challenges as part of our Global team while developing specialized expertise in supply chain operations. As the person who executes service delivery for our clients, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. You will be charged with helping Flexport account management teams and clients solve exceptional challenges in order to move their shipments in less time with lower costs and via improved productivity by your team, unblocking issues and establishing procedures to prevent them in the future.

Execute booking and documentation processes with clients /carriers

Timely shipment troubleshooting and exception escalation / handling

Work intimately with Flexport AM, Planning team to ensure an effective end to end export process.

Coach junior specialists on the daily job. 

Plan and execute special freight operations (i.e. DG, reefer, etc). 

Assist Sr. Associate on new business/process implementation, new projects and new tasks. 

Support internal and external clients to make the best decision with your expertise;

Live and act with integrity guided by the company values including sustaining a high bar for operational quality and service.

Inform the business process and software capability needs to help scale our growing team while improving quality, service, efficiency and regulatory compliance.

Contribute to the development and implementation of the procedure and system to differentiate Flexport operations from the industry.

What you will need: 

Experience:

BA/BS degree 

Minimum 3+ years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus) 

What you will learn: 

You will learn what it takes to lead small teams in the execution of day-to-day tactical tasks.

You will learn how to thrive in an ambiguous environment, research and test operational hypotheses and inform the strategy of a newly built team.

You will gain specialist expertise to become an ocean or network operations and intermodal subject matter expert within the company. You are the leading advisor in this area, someone our clients, partners, and internal teams go to for advice and strategy.

You will gain the ability to continuously improve the client experience through a deep industry understanding. You are singularly positioned to realize how we can both work within and push the logistics industry forward to meet the standards of Flexport’s client-centric service.

We are looking for an IT Auditor to join our Assurance practice and work alongside financial audit engagement teams. In this role, you will be the go-to person for all IT-related audit procedures — from understanding a client's IT environment and mapping IT General Controls, to extracting journal entry data from complex ERP systems and drafting IT-related findings for management letters.

What you'll be doing

Evaluate clients' IT environments as part of the audit team's risk assessment under SA 315, including understanding IT General Controls (ITGCs) over access security, change management, IT operations, and program development.

Assist engagement teams in assessing IT-dependent controls, system-generated reports, and automated interfaces that the financial audit relies upon.

Draft clear, well-structured IT-related findings and recommendations for inclusion in management letters and communications with Those Charged with Governance (TCWG).

title: Principal Product Manager - Discovery and Personalisation
job_description:
The Principal Product Manager for Discovery & Personalisation will own how subscribers find, explore and return to The Economist's journalism across web and app. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning two closely related disciplines:

Discovery. Owning the on-platform representation of our content - search, navigation, browse patterns and conversational interfaces that allow users to interrogate the archive and find authoritative journalism efficiently. This includes keyword and semantic search, ranking and surfacing logic, and generative AI features such as Q&A, content summarisation and conversational discovery experiences. A key part of this work is establishing the evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes that ensure AI-powered features are grounded in user trust and consistent with our editorial brand.       

Personalisation. Owning the recommendation and ranking algorithms that drive browse-led experiences — helping subscribers decide what to read, watch or listen to next. This means defining the behavioural signals and contextual inputs that feed personalisation models, partnering with data science on model development and evaluation, and ensuring our systems support habit formation without narrowing editorial perspective.

 The role interfaces with Web, App, Data science, Editorial and Analytics teams.

Responsibilities

Own the vision and roadmap for Discovery & Personalisation across web and app.

Lead the evolution of keyword and semantic search, including relevance, ranking and result quality.

Own browse-led personalisation systems — defining the signals, models and decisioning logic that surface relevant, timely content for individual subscribers.

Lead the creation of generative AI features including Q&A, content summarisation, explainer and conversational discovery experiences that help users explore and connect our journalism.

Establish robust evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes to ensure AI-powered features are accurate, transparent and aligned with our editorial values.

Partner closely with data science on the definition, evaluation and iteration of ranking and recommendation models.

Maintain strong judgement around responsible, transparent and editorially-aligned personalisation — preserving journalistic breadth and integrity.

Work closely with Editorial to ensure discovery and personalisation reflect journalistic judgement and trust, and that the right feedback loops are in place.

Collaborate with Web and App teams to ensure consistent, high-quality implementation of discovery and personalisation experiences across platforms.

Define and track success metrics related to findability, relevance, engagement, habit formation and trust.

Communicate strategy, priorities and performance clearly to senior stakeholders across product, editorial and technology.

The ideal skills for this role are:

Builder: You have owned and shipped complex search, discovery, recommendation or personalisation systems in content-rich or subscription products.

AI-fluent: You have hands-on experience defining and evaluating generative AI features — you understand the product, trust and editorial considerations that make AI experiences succeed or fail.

Data-informed: Comfortable working with data scientists on ML-driven systems, evaluation frameworks and experimentation.

Product-led: Strong judgement in defining strategy, translating it into roadmaps, and delivering outcomes through cross-functional teams in lean environments.

Editorially-aware: Confident balancing user intent, algorithmic optimisation and editorial integrity.

Communicator: Able to explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborative: Comfortable learning, iterating and working across disciplines — engineering, data science, design and editorial — in a fast-moving environment.

Domain knowledge

Search and discovery systems, including semantic retrieval, ranking and evaluation.

Personalisation systems, behavioral signals and experimentation.

Generative AI product development and conversational interface best practices.

Responsible AI, algorithmic transparency and human-in-the-loop design.

Metrics for discovery quality, relevance, user understanding and trust.

Subscription or habit-forming digital products.

Enthusiasm for The Economist's mission, journalism and global audience.

Paid Acquisition Strategy: Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display) to drive qualified signups and demo requests.

Funnel Integration: Build and optimize the acquisition-to-activation funnel, ensuring seamless integration between paid ads, landing pages, and product onboarding experience.

Technical Requirements (Must Have)

Digital Marketing Expertise: Proven hands-on experience running and optimizing Meta Ads campaigns (campaign structure, audience targeting, lookalike audiences, CAPI setup). Experience with Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, or Display) is a mandatory requirement.

Conversion Tracking: Deep understanding of the tracking ecosystem including Meta Pixel, CAPI, Google Tag Manager, and server-side tracking implementations.

Product Management: Ability to write clear PRDs, define user stories, and prioritize features based on impact and effort. Familiarity with agile development workflows.

Data & Analytics: Strong analytical skills with proficiency in spreadsheets, dashboard tools, or basic SQL. Ability to derive actionable insights from data.

A/B Testing: Proven ability to design and execute experiments on landing pages, ad creatives, and in-product flows.

Communication: Excellent communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia (mandatory) and English (at least passive).

Experience: 2+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, Growth PM, or Product Marketing Manager. SaaS or B2B background is a plus.

Nice to Have

SaaS Industry Experience: Prior experience working in B2B SaaS, communication platforms, or CRM products.

WhatsApp Business API Ecosystem: Familiarity with BSP (Business Solution Provider) workflows or official WhatsApp Business API implementations.

Analytics Tools: Experience with Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, or similar product analytics platforms.

Salesforce Data Analysis

Ensure reports are visually clear, accurate, and accessible for different management levels 

Forecasting & Pipeline Modeling 

Support the sales forecasting process by modeling expected revenue from open opportunities. 

Develop trend-based projections and scenario analyses to inform business planning. 

Validate forecast assumptions and flag potential risks or bottlenecks.  

Campaign & Program  Impact Analysis 

Measure the effectiveness of regional B2B campaigns and customer engagement programs.

Correlate engagement data (e.g., event attendance, specifications) with pipeline creation or conversion outcomes. 

Provide post-program analytics and recommendations for future initiatives.  

Market & External Data Integration 

Integrate external market intelligence (e.g., construction starts, project pipelines) with Salesforce data. 

Identify emerging market opportunities or segments with high growth potential.    

Produce insight summaries for sales and marketing planning sessions.  

Collaboration & Support for International Key Account and Local Key Account Teams 

Partner with International Key Account (IKA) and local sales teams to provide analytics support and reports. 

Respond to ad-hoc data requests and ensure data consistency across markets. 

Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Lead to align reporting structures with system standards.  

Data Quality Monitoring 

Monitor completeness and accuracy of Salesforce data; flag issues to market administrators. 

Support ongoing data cleansing and standardization efforts. 

Recommend process improvements to improve analytics reliability.




KEY RELATIONSHIP: 

This role works closely with the following functions:  

International Key Account and Local Key Account B2B Sales and Specs Teams 

Regional Channel Marketing 

Market Salesforce Administrators 

Commercial Leadership         




JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

Strong analytical thinking and storytelling with data

Deep familiarity with the ride-hailing and food delivery sectors.

1. PROJECT MANAGER CIVIL CONSTRUCTIONS

Quality Control :  inspeksi atas kualitas bangunan sipil (struktur, waterproof, lantai, dinding, atap, etc) terhadap gambar kerja, spesifikasi, dan standar data centre. Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap proses-proses krusial seperti pengecoran beton dan pelapisan kedap air, memantau tindak lanjut perbaikan atas temuan masalah mutu.

Manajemen & Koordinasi Proyek: Mengawasi pelaksanaan jadwal konstruksi sipil serta berkoordinasi dengan tim mekanikal, elektrikal, sistem arus lemah, perlindungan kebakaran, dan penyelesaian interior. Mengatasi permasalahan di lapangan yang berkaitan dengan gambar, proses kerja, maupun sumber daya.

Manajemen Gambar & Teknis: Melakukan penelaahan terhadap gambar kerja konstruksi, spesifikasi teknis, serta perubahan desain. Mengatur rapat pra-tender dan pemaparan teknis. Memberikan persetujuan atas rencana pelaksanaan konstruksi dan rencana khusus (struktur baja, tulangan, bekisting, perancah, beton, dan lain-lain). Menangani permasalahan teknis di lapangan serta memberikan saran optimalisasi.

Pengawasan Keselamatan & Lingkungan: Mengawasi penerapan langkah-langkah keselamatan di lokasi, memeriksa potensi risiko (tepi, bukaan, kelistrikan, pengangkatan). Melakukan tindak lanjut atas bahaya keselamatan dan berpartisipasi dalam inspeksi serta koordinasi keselamatan.

Dokumentasi & Penerimaan: Memastikan tim konstruksi dan pengawasan menyelesaikan dokumentasi, laporan pengujian, serta sertifikat material. Berpartisipasi dalam penerimaan sebagian maupun akhir proyek. Mengelola catatan, log, dan laporan yang berkaitan dengan proyek.

Komunikasi & Koordinasi Eksternal: Berhubungan dengan manajemen konsultan, pengawas, kontraktor utama, subkontraktor sipil, serta lembaga pengujian. Menangani inspeksi pemerintah (IMB, PBG, Perlindungan Kebakaran, dan lain-lain). Melakukan koordinasi dengan masyarakat setempat, wilayah sekitar, serta akses ke lokasi proyek apabila diperlukan.




2. MECHANICAL AND ELECTRICAL ENGINEER

Manajemen M&E : Mengelola sistem kelistrikan, perpipaan & drainase, serta HVAC di lapangan, memastikan pelaksanaan konstruksi sesuai dengan gambar, spesifikasi, dan standar Data Centre.

Manajemen Gambar & Teknis: Meninjau gambar kerja M&E, berpartisipasi dalam rapat pra-tender dan pengarahan teknis. Menyetujui rencana kerja dan langkah-langkah teknis, menyelesaikan masalah teknis di lapangan. Memastikan parameter, merek, dan model peralatan sesuai dengan persyaratan desain.

Quality Control Konstruksi: Memeriksa kualitas pemasangan kabel listrik, konduit, tray kabel, kotak distribusi, pipa air bersih dan pembuangan, katup, kipas, AC, dan ducting. Menyaksikan proses-proses penting seperti pekerjaan tertutup, uji tekanan, uji sistem air/listrik/pemanas. Mengeluarkan dan memantau perbaikan atas temuan kualitas.

Managejemen Koordinasi : Mengendalikan progres pekerjaan M&E, berkoordinasi dengan tim sipil, finishing, arus lemah, dan proteksi kebakaran. Mengelola koordinasi antar subkontraktor serta menyelesaikan konflik di lapangan.

Material & Peralatan: Menerima material dan peralatan kelistrikan, perpipaan & drainase, serta HVAC yang masuk. Memverifikasi sertifikat, laporan uji, merek, dan spesifikasi, serta mencatat kedatangan barang.

Commissioning & Penerimaan Sistem: Mengawasi proses commissioning sistem pencahayaan, daya, pemipaan air & drainase, air pemadam kebakaran, ventilasi, dan AC. Berpartisipasi dalam penerimaan proyek parsial maupun akhir.

Verifikasi Lapangan: Memverifikasi keaslian dan jumlah perubahan serta instruksi di lapangan.

Keselamatan & Dokumentasi: Mengawasi keselamatan kerja di lokasi selama penggunaan sementara listrik/air dan pekerjaan panas. Memastikan tim konstruksi melengkapi catatan uji, penerimaan pekerjaan tertutup, serta dokumentasi akhir.

Koordinasi Eksternal: Berkoordinasi dengan manajemen konsultasi, pengawas, kontraktor utama, subkontraktor M&E, dan produsen peralatan. Membantu pemilik untuk perizinan serta bekerja sama dengan lead engineer M&E dalam urusan penerimaan pemerintah dan terkait.




3. ADMIN PROJECT

Pengelolaan Dokumen menyeluruh : Mengumpulkan, mendaftarkan, mengklasifikasikan, mengarsipkan, dan menyimpan seluruh dokumen proyek (gambar, kontrak, perubahan, instruksi lapangan, formulir penerimaan, laporan uji, sertifikat, dan sebagainya).

Manajemen Gambar & Dokumen: Mengelola gambar konstruksi, perubahan desain, catatan negosiasi, dan formulir persetujuan teknis, memastikan versi yang valid digunakan di lapangan. Memelihara log penerbitan dan penerimaan gambar.

Dokumentasi Proses Konstruksi: Memastikan pengawas dan tim konstruksi mengatur dokumentasi untuk pekerjaan tertutup, lot inspeksi, dan penerimaan parsial/akhir sesuai standar Indonesia dan domestik. Memverifikasi agar dokumentasi selaras dengan progres di lapangan, autentik dan lengkap.

Membantu dokumen terkait perizinan: Menyusun dokumen untuk perizinan dan pengajuan proyek (IMB, PBG, PKPRR, Proteksi Kebakaran, Kelistrikan, dan lain-lain) serta memantau proses penyerahan dan umpan baliknya.

Dokumentasi atas Perubahan, SI & Pengukuran : Mengatur dokumen perubahan rekayasa, instruksi lapangan, dan pengajuan pembayaran progres. Memelihara log dan membantu Quantity Surveyor (QS) serta insinyur dalam proses review.

Dokumentasi Penerimaan & Penyelesaian: Menyusun, merangkum, mengatur, dan menyerahkan dokumen terkait penerimaan parsial dan akhir proyek. Mengarsipkan serta menyimpan gambar as-built, dokumen penyelesaian, dan informasi peralatan.

Manajemen Log & Arsip: Membuat dan memelihara log untuk dokumen proyek, file, sertifikat, serta penerbitan/penerimaan guna memastikan keterlacakan dan kemudahan pencarian.

Pekerjaan Kantor Harian & Dukungan: Mengatur notulen rapat, melaporkan informasi proyek, mendaftarkan peminjaman dokumen, serta menjaga kerahasiaan dokumen. Membantu departemen teknik dalam tugas-tugas harian.

Kualifikasi Utama:

Pendidikan min. S1 Teknik Sipil (pengalaman di industry Data Centre, Konstruksi ataupun Manufaktur Elektronik sangat diutamakan.)

Minimal 8 tahun pengalaman di bidang konstruksi dan sektor berisiko tinggi

Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat tentang izin legal, regulasi pemerintah, dan persyaratan kepatuhan

Berpengalaman dalam bernegosiasi dengan kontraktor dan mengelola kontrak yang kompleks

Terbukti mampu dalam mitigasi risiko , kepatuhan keselamatan , dan perencanaan tanggap darurat

Memiliki kemampuan yang sangat baik dalam pemecahan masalah, komunikasi, kolaborasi, dan penyelesaian konflik

Mampu menyeimbangkan pemikiran strategis dengan perhatian terhadap detail operasional

Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project , AUTOCAD serta perangkat lunak manajemen proyek lainnya yang relevan.




Kemampuan Bahasa - Fasih dalam Berbahasa Inggris dan Mandarin baik secara lisan maupun tulisan




Keunggulan bergabung dengan Kami :

Kesempatan berkarier di industry masa depan (Data Centre) yang sedang berkembang pesar di Batam




Lingkungan kerja professional dan bertaraf internasional

Paket kompensasi dan tunjangan yang kompetitif

title: Agrometeorologist / Precision Weather Specialist
job_description:
About the Company

PT Luwes Inovasi Mandiri is an Indonesian technology company engaged in weather monitoring, flood modelling, irrigation automation, geotechnical monitoring, and precision environmental data solutions.

We develop solutions based on IoT, satellite data, weather analytics, and artificial intelligence to support strategic sectors such as plantations, agriculture, mining, ports, and offshore operations.

Currently, PT Luwes Inovasi Mandiri is developing precision weather and soil moisture intelligence services in collaboration with international principal partners such as Spire.com and other global technology partners. These services are designed to support applications in palm oil plantations, agricultural irrigation, mining, and AI-based precision weather services for farming communities.

About the Role

We are looking for an Agrometeorologist with a background in meteorology or agrometeorology, strong analytical skills, and a strong interest in applying weather data, soil moisture analysis, and IoT technology to improve productivity in the agriculture and plantation sectors.

The ideal candidate is someone who can transform weather data, satellite data, and field sensor data into practical operational insights for the company and its clients.

Key Responsibilities

As an Agrometeorologist, you will be responsible for:

Processing and analyzing weather data from various sources, including satellite data, weather models, and external data providers.

Transforming precision weather data into daily operational recommendations to support plantation activities, particularly fertilization planning, water management, and run-off risk mitigation.

Managing analysis of soil moisture, rainfall, evapotranspiration, and Vapour Pressure Deficit/VPD to support precision water management.

Developing plantation water balance analysis to help minimize crop stress and maintain productivity.

Supporting the implementation and use of wireless soil sensors and IoT devices for real-time field condition monitoring.

Processing large datasets into practical insights using tools such as Python, Power BI, or other analytical software.

Preparing short-term and long-term climate planning to support risk mitigation for El Niño, La Niña, drought, and extreme rainfall events.

Collaborating with international experts, principal partners, and internal teams in the development of AI-based precision weather services.

Qualifications

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Meteorology, Agrometeorology, Climatology, Geophysics, Agricultural Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.

Strong understanding of the relationship between weather, soil moisture, rainfall, VPD, and crop productivity, particularly in palm oil plantations.

Experience in weather management or weather planning in palm oil plantations, agriculture, or irrigation is preferred.

Strong ability in numerical analysis, statistical analysis, and environmental data interpretation.

Experience working with weather data from external providers, prediction models, satellite data, or IoT-based monitoring systems.

Proficiency in Python, Power BI, GIS, or other data analytics tools.

Understanding of precision agriculture, water management, remote sensing, and environmental monitoring is an advantage.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical analysis into practical recommendations.

Growth mindset, proactive attitude, and willingness to collaborate with internal teams and international experts.

Why Join Us?

Receive advanced training from university researchers, principal partners, and international technology experts.

Work directly on projects involving precision weather, soil moisture intelligence, and environmental data solutions.

Take part in the development of nowcasting and precision weather services with global teams from Europe and the United States.

Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

Innovative work environment with career growth opportunities in climate tech, IoT, and AI-based environmental intelligence.

title: Supply Chain Manager
job_description:
Role Overview

The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing planning, inventory management, and warehouse operations in an Engineer-to-Order (ETO) manufacturing environment. 

This role ensures material availability aligned with engineering release and production schedules, while maintaining control over inventory, warehouse efficiency, and overall supply chain performance. This position does not include procurement responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Planning & Scheduling Excellence

Lead end-to-end planning processes in an ETO environment, including Master Production Scheduling (MPS), Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and capacity planning. 

Ensure alignment between engineering release, material availability, and production readiness. 

Manage long lead-time materials and complex bill of materials (BOM).  

Provide visibility on critical path, constraints, and material bottlenecks.

2. Systems & Planning Tools Governance

Own and optimize planning systems, including SAP (MRP, PP, MM).

Utilize advanced planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, Trello, or similar platforms.

Ensure accuracy of master data, including BOM, lead times, routings, and inventory parameters.

Drive digitalization and automation of planning processes.

3. Inventory Management & Working Capital

Define and implement inventory strategies aligned with ETO variability and project timelines.

Optimize inventory levels, safety stock policies, and material availability.

Balance service level and working capital targets.

Monitor and improve KPIs such as inventory turnover, stock accuracy, and excess and obsolete materials.

4. Warehouse & Internal Logistics

Lead warehouse operations ensuring efficient material flow, proper storage conditions, and full traceability.

Ensure high standards of inventory accuracy and material handling.

Optimize warehouse layout and internal logistics processes.

Implement digital tracking and control systems where applicable.

5. Cross-Functional Integration

Act as the key interface between Engineering, Production, Project Management, and Procurement (interface only).

Ensure coordination between design release and material readiness.

Support execution with clear visibility of material-related risks.

6. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

Define and monitor KPIs such as material availability, planning adherence, and inventory performance.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and process optimization methodologies.

Promote standardization and discipline across planning and logistics processes.

7. Risk Management

Identify and manage risks related to material shortages, planning deviations, and inventory imbalances.

Develop mitigation plans and escalation routines to ensure continuity of operations.


﻿Qualifications

Experience 8 to 12+ years of experience in Supply Chain, with strong focus on planning, inventory management, and logistics.

Proven experience in Engineer-to-Order (ETO) or project-based manufacturing environments. 

Experience in transformers, heavy electrical equipment, or similar industries is highly preferred.

Technical Skills

Strong expertise in SAP (MRP, PP, MM) or equivalent ERP systems.

Experience with planning and scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera, Trello, or similar platforms. 

Deep understanding of MRP, MPS, capacity planning, and complex BOM structures. 

Advanced analytical skills, including Excel and reporting tools. 

Leadership & Competencies

Strong leadership and ability to work across cross-functional teams.

High level of discipline in planning and execution.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in complex, project-driven environments.

Fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

APICS certifications (CPIM or CSCP).

Experience with digital supply chain or planning transformation initiatives.

Kami dari pt gracio sentosa bersama' mencari kandidat yang berpengalaman sebagai OPERATOR MESIN BLOW PLASTIK untuk bergabung bersama kami di Sidoarjo Jawa Timur. title: Digital Product Owner (Life Insurance)
job_description:
Job Summary

A Digital Product Owner plays a crucial role in guiding the development of digital products, ensuring they meet user needs and business goals. 

Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree: Often in business, marketing, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related discipline

Min. 3 years of experiences in digital product management, optimization, analytics, digital marketing or related roles is required.

Familiarity with the insurance or Insurtech industry is advantageous.

Understanding of backend development processes, UX/UI principles, optimization software (e.g., Google Analytics, A/B testing tools) and familiarity with web technologies.

Ability to interpret data, conduct market research, and make data-driven decisions, strong ability to analyze data, identify trends, and derive actionable insights. Understanding in GA Tools is required

Experience with agile methodologies and tools like Jira, Trello, Figma, Mural is required

Strong English verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional and regional teams plus ability to present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders are required

Skills in user research, personas, and understanding customer / partners needs is required

Job Accountabilities - Key Accountabilities

Product Vision and Strategy: Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and roadmap, aligning with stakeholder / Partners / Customers needs and company objectives.

Backlog Management & Requirement Gathering: Prioritize and manage the product backlog, ensuring that it reflects the needs of users and stakeholders. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and define product requirements and user stories.

User Experience Focus: Work closely with UX/UI designers to ensure that the product delivers a high-quality user experience.

Development: Participate in Agile Activities (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) and provide clear direction to the development team.

Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration: Regularly communicate product progress and updates to stakeholders, gathering feedback for continuous improvement. Act as a liaison between cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and effective communication.

Performance Tracking: Monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends to make informed decisions and adjustments. Analyze product performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, A/B testing platforms, and user feedback to identify areas for improvement.

Optimization Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to enhance product features, user experience, and conversion rates.

A/B Testing & User Research: Design and conduct A/B tests and experiments to evaluate new features and optimizations, analyzing results to inform decisions. Conduct user research and gather qualitative and quantitative data to understand user behavior, preferences, and pain points.

Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement by staying updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies. Create regular discussion to communicate findings, insights, and recommendations to related stakeholders & working group.

Customer Feedback: Gather and analyze customer feedback through surveys, interviews, and usability tests to drive product enhancements.

title: Senior Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer
job_description:
FINNS Beach Club is seeking a Senior Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer to take ownership of both electrical infrastructure and instrumentation systems, acting as the foundation for future automation and smart operations across the venue.

This role extends beyond traditional electrical engineering. You will be the key driver in building an integrated, data-driven environment, enabling real-time monitoring, control, and optimization of critical systems such as power, water, wastewater, HVAC, and energy consumption.

You will play a central role in transitioning FINNS toward a digitally enabled, intelligent facility, where decisions are supported by accurate data and automated control systems.

Summary

FINNS World's Best Beach Club is not just a beach club; it's a destination where dreams come alive! We pride ourselves on creating exhilarating entertainment, vibrant energy, and unforgettable F&B experiences. Nestled along the breathtaking Bali coastline, we provide a one-of-a-kind party atmosphere that leaves our guests craving for more.

Responsibilities

1.Electrical Engineering Leadership

Lead design, operation, and optimization of electrical systems including LV/MV distribution, panels, protection systems, and backup power (generator, ATS)

Act as the technical authority for electrical reliability, safety, and system resilience

Oversee electrical inputs in projects, upgrades, and retrofits, ensuring alignment with operational requirements

2.Instrumentation & Automation (Core Focus)

Develop and implement instrumentation architecture across critical systems, including:

Flow meters, level sensors, pressure transmitters, temperature sensors

Power meters, energy monitoring systems, and load analytics

Water quality sensors for WTP/WWTP (pH, DO, turbidity, etc.)

Lead deployment and integration of PLC/SCADA/BMS systems to enable centralized monitoring and control

Design and standardize data acquisition frameworks, ensuring all critical assets are measurable and trackable

Drive implementation of smart alarms, interlocks, and predictive maintenance triggers

Support development of AI-driven automation initiatives, including energy optimization, demand response, and system self-correction

3.Systems Integration & Data Strategy

Integrate electrical and mechanical systems into a unified Building Management System (BMS)

Ensure interoperability between legacy systems and new digital platforms

Establish data standards, dashboards, and reporting structures to support operational decision-making

Work closely with IT and digital teams to align on infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data governance

4.Operational Excellence & Compliance

Conduct technical audits and performance reviews across electrical and instrumentation systems

Lead root cause analysis for system failures, including both electrical faults and instrumentation inaccuracies

Ensure compliance with Indonesian regulations, safety standards, and calibration requirements

Develop and enforce SOPs for instrumentation calibration, maintenance, and verification

5.Commercial & Strategic Contribution

Support CAPEX planning and ROI justification for automation and instrumentation investments

Evaluate and manage vendors for instrumentation, control systems, and smart technologies

Contribute to tendering, procurement, and contract negotiation from a technical perspective

Qualifications

Minimum 8–12 years of experience, with strong exposure to both electrical systems and instrumentation/control systems

Excellent communication skills in English both written and verbal are essential

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or related field

Proven experience with PLC, SCADA, BMS, and industrial automation systems

Strong understanding of instrumentation design, calibration, and signal integration (4-20 mA, Modbus, BACnet, etc.)

Experience in energy monitoring systems, smart metering, and data analytics platforms

Familiarity with AI-driven automation or predictive maintenance frameworks is highly advantageous

Strong knowledge of Indonesian regulations, electrical codes, and instrumentation standards

Experience in complex facilities, hospitality, industrial plants, or high-load environments

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking capability

Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive digital transformation initiatives

title: Quality Control Engineer
job_description:
A key responsibility of the QC Engineer is to maintain and oversee NDT compliance, including ensuring that NDT personnel qualifications meet required standards and that inspections such as visual testing and other NDT methods are conducted properly. The position also requires reviewing inspection records and maintaining proper documentation in the Master Control System, ensuring all quality reports, inspection records, and data books are accurate and issued in a timely manner.

Operationally, the QC Engineer supervises daily shop floor inspection activities, conducts project briefings with inspectors, and coordinates closely with production teams to ensure inspection requirements align with manufacturing schedules. The role also involves preparing and updating quality plans, Inspection Test Plans (ITP), and inspection notifications, as well as issuing test requests and coordinating testing activities with vendors and third-party service providers.

The QC Engineer plays a critical role in identifying and managing nonconformities (NCRs) by initiating reports, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and improvement actions to prevent recurrence. The role also requires regular communication and coordination with customers, third-party inspectors (TPI), and vendors during inspection and surveillance activities, ensuring transparency and prompt response to customer complaints or quality issues.

In addition, the QC Engineer is responsible for monitoring inspection results, reviewing NDT findings, verifying calibration of inspection tools and equipment, and ensuring the validity of inspection data. The role includes preparing weekly reports on QC activities for the QHSE Manager, as well as generating monthly statistics on welder performance. The QC Engineer may also be required to plan QC resources for weekend work to meet production and customer requirements.

From a governance and compliance perspective, the QC Engineer ensures adherence to Oil States Industries’ HSE policies and Quality Management System, participates in internal and external vendor audits, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening quality control processes.

The position requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent, along with professional certifications such as AWS or CSWIP Welding Inspector and ASNT NDT Level II or equivalent. Strong technical knowledge of relevant standards—including API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 1104, API STD 64, NACE MR0175, ASME Section VIII and IX, and ASTM NDT standards—is essential.

Candidates are expected to have a minimum of seven years of experience as a QC Engineer, including at least four years in the manufacturing, repair, or remanufacturing of drilling equipment and tubular products, as well as experience supervising inspection teams, training personnel, and participating in quality audits. Strong communication, leadership, teamwork, and presentation skills, along with the ability to effectively manage quality-related issues with internal and external stakeholders, are critical for success in this role.

With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

This role ensures adherence to operational plans and technical standards while promoting safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement. The position also plays a key role in developing technicians capabilities and fostering a safety-first culture

Key Responsibilities

Operational Maintenance

﻿Implement and supervise scheduled preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment modification.

Assign daily tasks to technicians based on operational priorities and ensure availability of necessary tools and spare parts.

Conduct monthly inspections using standardized checklists to maintain equipment reliability and performance.

Ensure maintenance work, whether internal or vendor-executed, complies with established technical standards and quality requirements.

Team Management & Development

﻿Coach, guide, and evaluate technicians to ensure team performance and individual competency growth.

Provide training and mentoring to less experienced team members, supporting a culture of continuous learning.

Coordinate with technicians to execute maintenance plans effectively.

Safety & Compliance

Promote and monitor the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (K3) procedures during all maintenance activities.

Lead safety talks, inspections, and investigations to prevent incidents and foster safety awareness.

Take immediate action to stop operations in the event of unsafe conditions and initiate corrective measures.

Process Improvement & Reporting

Analyze maintenance data to reduce repetitive repairs and unscheduled downtime by improving preventive and predictive maintenance.

Review technician requests for parts and consumables, verifying quantity and specification accuracy.

Prepare reports such as Breakdown Reports and Machine Condition Reports (MCR) in alignment with maintenance plans.

Recommend improvements, including unit modifications, facility needs, and critical spare part requirements.

Internal & External Coordination

Maintain effective communication with Operations, Planning, Warehouse, and Admin teams to ensure smooth coordination of maintenance activities.

Liaise with external vendors, Pelindo, and relevant authorities such as Biro Klasifikasi Indonesia for maintenance and compliance matters.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelors degree (S1/D4) in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering disciplines.

Experience: Minimum 5 years in a similar position (Mechancial Supervisor or Electrical Supervisor) or relevant industry role.

Competencies:

Strong technical knowledge in preventive and corrective maintenance practices.

Proven leadership and team coordination skills.

High attention to safety, quality, and operational detail.

Proficiency in maintenance reporting and equipment troubleshooting.

Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration ability

4. Big Data Tools: Knowledge of platforms like Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, or Flink for processing large datasets.
Problem Solving: Analytical skills for troubleshooting pipeline issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring data integrity.

Core Responsibilities
1. Data Pipeline Development and Management
Data engineers create and manage the pipelines that extract data from various sources, transform it into usable formats, and load it into databases or data warehouses (ETL/ELT processes). They ensure that data flows reliably from source systems to reporting and analytics platforms.
2. Data Storage and Architecture
They design and maintain scalable and secure data storage solutions, such as relational databases, NoSQL databases, and cloud-based data warehouses. They establish schemas, indexing strategies, and storage models optimized for performance and analytics.
3. Data Quality and Governance
Data engineers enforce data quality standards, implement validation and cleansing processes, and monitor pipelines to detect and resolve inconsistencies. They also ensure compliance with data governance policies and standards, including privacy regulations.
4. Performance Optimization and Scalability
Optimizing database queries, improving pipeline performance, and planning for scalable infrastructure to manage growing datasets are key responsibilities. This includes tuning systems to handle large-scale batch and real-time processing efficiently.
5. Collaboration with Stakeholders
Data engineers work closely with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to understand their data requirements and provide reliable datasets for analysis, reporting, and machine learning applications.
6. Tooling and Automation
They leverage tools such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Airflow, and cloud services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform to automate workflows and manage large-scale data processing.

title: Junior AI Engineer
job_description:
About Us:
At PT Pro Teknologi Siber, we're at the cutting edge of AI innovation. Our mission is to drive transformative solutions using the power of artificial intelligence to shape the future of computer vision. We believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and personal growth. Our team thrives on challenging projects that make a real-world impact, and we're excited to expand our AI capabilities with driven, passionate individuals like you.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Junior AI Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of AI models, including computer vision applications. In this role, you’ll assist in designing, implementing, and optimizing AI systems using machine learning and deep learning techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and object detection frameworks. You'll play a key role in data preprocessing, ensuring data quality and integrity, while also supporting the testing and validation of computer vision models. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers to learn and grow in this rapidly evolving field.

What You'll Do:

Develop AI & Computer Vision Models: Assist in the creation and refinement of machine learning and deep learning models, including computer vision applications like image classification, object detection, and image segmentation using frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.

Code Implementation: Write clean, efficient, and scalable code in Python, Java, or Scala to implement AI algorithms, particularly for computer vision tasks.

Data Management: Support the team in managing, cleaning, and preprocessing image and video data, ensuring high-quality inputs for training and evaluation of computer vision models.

Testing & Validation: Help test and validate AI and computer vision systems, ensuring their performance and reliability across a variety of use cases.

Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and computer vision, integrating new techniques into your work to improve model performance and innovation.

Team Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams, contributing ideas and solutions while also enhancing your own technical skills.

What We're Looking For:

Educational Background: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Technical Skills: Experience or coursework in machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision, with proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala. Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, OpenCV, or similar is a plus.

Data Handling: Solid understanding of data preprocessing techniques, especially for image and video data, and familiarity with data augmentation and annotation methods for computer vision tasks.

Problem-Solving Mindset: A curious and analytical mindset, eager to tackle complex computer vision problems and innovate.

Team Player: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and learn from others.

Growth-Oriented: Passionate about AI and computer vision, with a desire to continuously develop your technical skills and knowledge.

Why Join Us?

Learning & Development: Be part of a culture that encourages continuous learning and professional growth, with access to resources, mentorship, and real-world experience.

Impactful Work: Contribute to projects that make a meaningful impact in [industry or field], using AI and computer vision to solve real-world challenges.

Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team of engineers and AI experts who support each other’s growth and innovation.

Innovation at Scale: Engage with some of the most cutting-edge AI technologies and tools to create solutions that will shape the future.

We are seeking candidates who are not only qualified but also possess genuine interest in joining and growing with our team. If you are considering multiple offers or are still uncertain, we appreciate your honesty at the outset of the process.

If you're excited about the potential of AI and computer vision and are looking for an opportunity to grow in a supportive, forward-thinking company, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Lab Analyst
job_description:
Job description: 

Perform laboratory examinations in hematology, chemistry, serology, urine, feces, and body fluids in accordance with established procedures and service standards to support doctors’ diagnoses.

Experienced in performing daily quality control (QC). 

Experience in a middle managerial role is an advantage.

About Ohmyhome

(https://www.ohmyhome.com)

We make housing transactions Simple, Fast & Affordable.

As Singapore’s first one-stop property solution, Ohmyhome combines a powerful DIY platform with expert agent services to simplify buying, selling, and renting homes. Our all-in-one ecosystem is driven by data and technology, enabling seamless, efficient, and transparent property journeys.

With our expansion into the Philippines, we are building the region’s first cross-border, data-driven property platform—and data is at the core of everything we do.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale our data infrastructure powering key products across the business.

You will own end-to-end data pipelines, with a strong focus on geospatial and property data, and play a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across product, operations, and growth teams.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with high ownership in shaping how data systems are built and scaled.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) across multiple data sources

Architect and optimize data lakes, warehouses, and data models for analytics and product use cases

Improve data quality, performance, and pipeline reliability

Work with large-scale geospatial and property datasets to power core product features

Build and maintain batch and near real-time data processing systems

Develop internal tools and datasets that provide actionable insights (e.g., pricing, customer behavior, operational performance)

Collaborate with product, analytics, and engineering teams to translate business needs into data solutions

Contribute to data standards, best practices, and system design decisions

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles

Strong hands-on experience with:

SQL and relational databases

Python for data processing and automation

Proven experience building and optimizing data pipelines and data architectures at scale

Strong understanding of:

Data modeling and database design

ETL/ELT processes and orchestration

Data warehousing concepts

Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure)

Experience working with:

Cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake)

Orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)

Transformation tools (e.g., DBT)

Experience integrating data from APIs and multiple data sources

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have

Experience working with geospatial data (GIS, mapping, location intelligence)

Background in PropTech, FinTech, or marketplace platforms

Exposure to machine learning pipelines or AI-related data workflows

Familiarity with real-time data streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub, etc.)

What You’ll Build

Data pipelines powering property valuation and pricing insights

Data systems supporting buyer/seller matching and recommendations

Analytics infrastructure for customer acquisition, funnel tracking, and operations

Scalable data architecture supporting multi-country expansion






Why Join Us

Work on data systems that impact real-life decisions—homes, investments, and life milestones

High ownership role with the opportunity to shape core data infrastructure

Collaborate with a product-driven, cross-functional team

Be part of a fast-growing PropTech company expanding across Southeast Asia

How to Apply

Share your resume and any relevant projects or data systems you’ve built at marie@ohmyhome.com or contact HR at +63917 707 6589

title: Data Enginner & Analyst
job_description:
Pipeline Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to accurately extract, transform, and load diverse datasets—including shipment data, sales & marketing performance, comprehensive financials, and truck/container asset utilization—into the centralized data warehouse.

External Data Integration (NEW): Design and implement processes to acquire and integrate data from external sources, such as public APIs, third-party logistics platforms, or market rate providers, to enrich internal datasets.

Data Modeling: Apply data warehousing principles (e.g., star schema) to model complex freight forwarding data, ensuring high data quality, consistency, and efficient query performance for reporting.

Data Governance: Ensure the integrity, security, and cleanliness of data sources, primarily using advanced SQL scripting for data manipulation and validation.

Source Management: Troubleshoot and optimize data ingestion from various source systems, including direct connections to the ERP system and management of crucial Excel files.

Develop and maintain cross-department dashboards (finance, commercial, trucking, operations, HR, etc).

Dashboard Development: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of professional, interactive business intelligence dashboards and reports primarily using Microsoft Power BI.

Advanced Analytics: Conduct deep-dive analysis on key business areas, such as: Operational Efficiency: Analyze shipment transit times, identify bottlenecks in specific transport modes (FCL/LCL, FTL/LTL), and calculate asset utilization rates; Financial Performance: Analyze profitability per shipment, dissect operational costs, and perform margin analysis on sales data; Sales Insights: Evaluate market trends and assess the performance of sales & marketing initiatives.

Insight Generation: Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for senior management and operational teams to optimize routes, pricing, and asset deployment.

Technical Reporting: Utilize advanced features within Power BI, including mastering the DAX language, to create sophisticated measures and calculations.




Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or related field.

3–5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence.

Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation, validation, and governance.

Expertise in Microsoft Power BI or other data visualization tools, including advanced DAX and dashboard/report development.

Familiarity with ERP systems and integration of external data sources (APIs, logistics platforms, market rate providers).

 Ability to perform deep-dive analysis on operational efficiency, financial performance, and sales/marketing initiatives.

Knowledge of freight forwarding services (Ocean FCL/LCL, Air, Road FTL/LTL) and related KPIs is a significant advantage.

Self-driven, detail-oriented, and capable of owning end-to-end analytical infrastructure.

title: Project Engineer
job_description:
Job Summary:

Datalec Precision Installations (DPI) is a leading provider of data centre design, supply, build, and managed services. We are committed to delivering seamless and integrated solutions for data centre operators worldwide. Our team is dedicated to maintaining high standards of service and excellence in every project we undertake.

We are seeking a Project Engineer to join our Team.  This role will oversee the engineering execution and site coordination of structured cabling infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data center projects across the APAC region. This role bridges engineering design and field implementation, ensuring quality, schedule, and cost targets are met—while promoting the use of AI-enabled construction platforms to optimize design validation, material tracking, and installation workflows.

 Core Duties & Responsibilities

·       Manage end-to-end project engineering activities including review of IFC drawings, site coordination, and as-built documentation.

·       Provide technical guidance on copper/fiber cabling systems, containment routing, patch panel layouts, and rack configurations.

·       Review shop drawings, cable schedules, and RFIs to ensure alignment with project requirements and industry standards (TIA/EIA, BICSI).

·       Utilize AI-based site capture tools (e.g., OpenSpace, Buildots, Disperse) for real-time installation tracking, deviation detection, and QA verification.

·       Support AI-assisted cable routing validation and digital twin modeling using BIM platforms with structured cabling plugins.

·       Apply AI analytics and dashboards to monitor productivity, forecast risks, and identify performance issues across projects.

·       Coordinate with general contractors, MEP trades, and ICT vendors to align structured cabling scope with overall project timeline and milestones.

·       Support site supervisors in managing cable pulling, termination, testing, and labeling activities in accordance with method statements.

·       Conduct site walks, inspections, and technical meetings to drive issue resolution and maintain construction quality.

·       Material & Progress Management

·       Oversee materials take-off, procurement tracking, and inventory management using digital tools.

·       Ensure timely submission and approval of documentation, including test reports, handover packages, and redlines.

·       Update project trackers and contribute to client reports on engineering and site progress.

·       Represent the business, upholding our core values and behaviours with all internal and external customers, clients and third parties,

·       Maintain business and client confidentiality, adhering to applicable Data Protection regulations and Information Security Standards in line with company, and group policies and procedures.

 Qualifications: Skills and Experience

·       Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.

·       3–6 years of experience in structured cabling system implementation, preferably in data center or mission-critical environments.

·       Strong understanding of TIA, ISO/IEC cabling standards, and hands-on knowledge of fiber optics, copper systems, and cable testing procedures.

·       Proficient in AutoCAD; familiarity with Revit, BIM 360, and construction analytics platforms is a plus.

·       Experience or interest in AI tools for construction monitoring, routing optimization, or material forecasting.

·       Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

·       Willingness to travel regionally within APAC.

Preferred certifications:

·       BICSI RCDD or Technician Certification

·       PMP or equivalent project coordination training

·       Training in AI/digital tools for construction (e.g., OpenSpace, Autodesk AI, Disperse)


Values & Behaviours:

 DPI Values

                                          Dedication                Precision                   Integrity

 Behaviours

 ·      Inspiration - Has a clear vision of where to go and the ability to articulate it. Empowers people to implement our vision and strategy. Great communicator who captures the imagination, generating trust and commitment.

 ·      Team Spirit - Thinks about "we" not "me"; we do this together. Brings purpose to the team to make it a cohesive unit. Knows when to seek help and when to give it. Prepared to take action to address issues for the good of the team and celebrate others' successes.

 ·      Self-Awareness - Emotionally intelligent; has empathy for others and gets the best out of people by meeting them on their terms. Great at building rapport with colleagues and customers; knows that their behavior impacts on the performance of others and adapts approach to achieve the best results.

 ·      Achievement - Always striving to be the best and consistently delivers. High performer: bringing high energy, competence and making the right decisions to get things done.

 ·      Tenacity - Relentless in the pursuit of their goals. Excellent at solving problems and overcoming obstacles; seeing the challenges before others see them and taking action, to avoid them becoming problems. Sees setbacks as opportunities and becomes stronger in adversity.

 ·      Influence - Highly skilled at getting others committed to the goal. Confident, enthusiastic and encourages creativity. Understands the needs of stakeholders and as a result, engages them.

 Our Vision

 ·      To compete at the highest standards in data centre fit-out, MEP construction and managed services throughout Europe and beyond.

 Our Mission

·      Continue to develop and deliver products and services unparalleled in terms of quality.

·      Retain our clients, broaden our breadth of service identifying closely with their changing requirements.

·      Execute a robust H&S and Wellbeing strategy.  Consider and implement wherever possible initiatives that relate to environmental improvements.

 Our Strategy

 ·      People - Build an organisation capable of managing the business we will become.  Recruit and retain and develop the best industry professionals.  Health, Safety and Wellbeing remain paramount, for our employees and clients.

·      Products - must address an industry need. We must have differentiators such as assured quality, modularisation, and off-site construction techniques. Datalec’s commitment to quality is unsurpassed in the industry, we seek perfection.  New products and services must be delivered to the same exacting standards.

·      Purpose - relates both to our clients and our organisation. We need to understand both how to be able to confidently present our solutions and product strategy to the market. Separately, we create a working environment that promotes and rewards employees fairly, actively supporting a culture of transparency and mutual respect.

Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to better understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers. Its products range from intensive research studies to simple surveys and can be arranged on a project or subscription basis.
