Populix is building the future of AI-powered market research, combining structured data, unstructured insights, and generative AI into a seamless research intelligence platform. We're looking for a Lead Data Scientist to help drive that vision forward, someone who can spearhead the development of simulation systems and automation pipelines, while actively supporting the Head of Data Science in shaping our AI research strategy.

This role will be at the forefront of building simulation modeling, scaling automation for text and audio-based survey data, and translating our research into whitepapers that position Populix as a thought leader in the region. You'll also play a key role in advancing our use of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and modular AI architectures to deliver insights that are fast, accurate, and contextualized.

Lead the Design and implementation of behavioral simulation responses and demographic patterns using generative models, statistical modeling, and controlled simulations.
Collaborate with the research and marketing teams to create simulation-driven whitepapers and internal studies, helping communicate the value of synthetic insight across use cases like campaign testing, segmentation, and hypothetical trends.

Collaborate closely with engineers, designers, and product teams to ship robust ML-powered tools into production across the Populix platform.
Provide mentorship to other data scientists, sharing knowledge, reviewing modeling work, and helping maintain a culture of experimentation, reproducibility, and ethical AI.

5+ years of experience in data science or applied machine learning, including at least 1 year in a technical leadership role
Deep experience in generative modeling (e.g., GANs, VAEs), simulation, or behavioral data modeling, with a strong grounding in statistics and hypothesis testing.

Solid programming skills in Python and experience with tools like LangGraph, LangSmith, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or equivalent frameworks.

Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex modeling approaches into product or research value.

Knowledge of synthetic data generation ethics, validation strategies, and mixed-method evaluation

title: Rekrutmen Data Inputter
job_description:
Latar Belakang

Tuberkulosis (TB) tetap menjadi salah satu tantangan kesehatan masyarakat paling mendesak di Indonesia. Pada tahun 2024, diperkirakan terdapat 1.092.000 kasus TB di Indonesia, dengan 856.420 kasus yang telah dilaporkan, termasuk 12.128 orang dengan TB resisten obat (DR-TB). Meskipun terdapat kemajuan dalam pelaporan kasus, masih terdapat kesenjangan signifikan dalam cakupan dan keterlibatan pengobatan. Sebagai contoh, dari kasus DR-TB yang dilaporkan, hanya 9.573 pasien yang memulai pengobatan. Tingkat keberhasilan pengobatan juga menunjukkan ketimpangan, dengan beberapa wilayah mencatat keberhasilan 85% untuk TB sensitif obat (DS-TB), namun hanya 59% untuk DR-TB. Selain itu, cakupan terapi pencegahan TB (TPT) masih sangat rendah—hanya 19,4% pada tahun 2024.

Selama bertahun-tahun, Indonesia telah menerima dukungan substansial dari berbagai mitra, termasuk Badan Pembangunan Internasional Amerika Serikat (USAID), untuk memperkuat penemuan kasus TB, meningkatkan layanan pengobatan, mendorong keterlibatan masyarakat, dan membangun kolaborasi lintas sektor. Namun, dengan berakhirnya pendanaan program TB dari USAID, sejumlah intervensi penyelamatan jiwa kini menghadapi kesenjangan dukungan yang kritis, yang mengancam keberlanjutan dan kualitas layanan TB di wilayah dengan beban tinggi.

Pemerintah Amerika kembali mendukung Indonesia upaya eliminasi TB melalui Proyek Life-saving Facility and Community-based Service Delivery Support for Tuberculosis (FCSDS) untuk periode Oktober 2025-Maret 2026 yang dirancang untuk mendorong peningkatan penemuan kasus TB secara dini dan membantu pasien dalam mengakses layanan TB yang berkualitas, termasuk diagnosis yang tepat waktu, pengobatan yang efektif, dan pemberian TPT, dengan fokus khusus pada provinsi dan kabupaten yang saat ini menghadapi tantangan terbesar dalam menjaga keberlanjutan layanan TB.

STPI akan memimpin pelaksanaan proyek ini. Melalui kolaborasi erat dengan layanan kesehatan pemerintah, masyarakat sipil, dan aktor komunitas, proyek ini akan memperkuat layanan TB baik di fasilitas kesehatan maupun berbasis komunitas. Kegiatan akan mencakup peningkatan deteksi dini kasus, peningkatan inisiasi dan kepatuhan pengobatan, perluasan cakupan TPT, serta memastikan dukungan pasien sepanjang perjalanan pengobatan. Dengan menjembatani kesenjangan layanan dan menjaga intervensi penting, Proyek FCSDS bertujuan untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, mengurangi penularan TB, dan melindungi komunitas rentan dari epidemi TB yang masih berlangsung di Indonesia.

Pelaksanaan proyek berfokus di Puskesmas, terutama pada upaya investigasi kontak, community outreach,  skrining sistematis TB (SSTB) dan pendampingan orang dengan TB di masyarakat. Data Inputter dibutuhkan untuk menjadi penghubung dan memfasilitasi kebutuhan kader maupun puskesmas untuk pendataan, pemberian insentif, dan pelaporan terkait upaya yang dilakukan dalam rangka pelaksanaan proyek. Sebelumnya Proyek FCSDS telah merekrut untuk posisi Data Entry, yang selanjutnya akan diubah namanya menjadi Data Inputter dengan penyesuaian tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.

Wilayah kerja Data Inputter dapat meliputi satu atau lebih Puskesmas dan akan bertanggung jawab kepada Koordinator Distrik, selain itu koordinasi dengan Wasor TB di Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten, dan Penanggung Jawab TB di Puskesmas harus terus dilakukan.

Advanced degree in a quantitative field or equivalent experience, and 3+ years building/launching computer vision & deep learning models (biometrics, PAD, or deepfake detection preferred).
Strong CV/DL fundamentals: modern backbones/transformers, temporal models, contrastive/metric learning, robustness techniques.
Proficient in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow); OpenCV/FFmpeg; proven track record taking models from notebook → production with experiment tracking, CI/CD, and post-deploy monitoring.
Clear communication, ownership mindset, and bias to ship.

Deepfake forensics (GAN/diffusion artifacts, watermark/signature checks).
On-device/low-latency inference (TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, TFLite, Core ML, NNAPI), CUDA kernels, or inference compilers.
Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure for model deployment.

Synthetic data/simulation to cover rare attacks.

Legally valid digital signatures ensuring secure and scalable identity solutions.

About VIDA

VIDA builds identity platforms and secure credentialing systems used by Financial, government services, and enterprise customers to verify and manage digital identity at scale. Our products combine high-availability platforms, PKI/CA integrations, and audit-grade logging to deliver tamper-resistant authentication, credential issuance, and secure API gateways. Role summary

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Data Center Network Engineer to design, implement, and operate our Jakarta data center and enterprise networks. You’ll own HLD/LLD, deployments, monitoring, and incident resolution for Nexus/Catalyst environments, MPLS backbones, and overlay fabrics — with a strong emphasis on uptime, security, and audit readiness.

Key responsibilities

Lead end-to-end network design, implementation, and production support for data center and enterprise networks.
Produce and maintain HLDs, LLDs, runbooks and UAT test scripts; conduct knowledge transfers.
Design and operate Cisco Nexus-based fabric (leaf/spine, vPC), campus Catalyst switching, and WAN/MPLS backbones.
Implement and troubleshoot routing (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP), MPLS (LDP, L2VPN, L3VPN, MPLS-TE) and overlay tech (VXLAN, IPsec, OTV, ACI).
Harden networks for security and compliance: segmentation, port security, ACLs, route filtering, PBR and QoS.
Lead change management for high-availability environments; perform staging and validation for device rollouts.
Drive incident response for packet loss, path anomalies and performance degradation; perform RCA and mitigation.
Coordinate with platform, security and compliance teams to ensure audit readiness (CA/PKI integrations, ISO, WebTrust) and assist during audits.

Required qualifications

7+ years in enterprise and data center networking with demonstrable hands-on experience designing and operating production networks.
Deep practical knowledge of MPLS backbone technologies and multi-vendor WAN environments.
Strong routing and switching skills: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, VLANs, Spanning Tree variants, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP.
Proven experience with Nexus (N3K/N5K/N7K/N9K) and Catalyst platforms; experience with fabric/leaf-spine architectures.
Solid troubleshooting skills for packet flows, QoS, routing policies and overlay overlays.
Experience creating HLD/LLD, performing UAT and delivering knowledge transfers.

title: DevOps

Description


DevOps Engineer adalah profesional IT yang bertanggung jawab menggabungkan proses development (Dev) dan operations (Ops) agar proses pengembangan, deployment, dan pengelolaan aplikasi berjalan lebih cepat, stabil, dan otomatis.

Berikut job desk / tanggung jawab utama DevOps Engineer:

1. Mengelola Infrastruktur Server
• Mengatur dan memelihara server, cloud, atau infrastruktur IT.
• Menggunakan platform seperti: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, VPS / dedicated server

2. Continuous Integration & Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
• Membuat dan mengelola pipeline CI/CD untuk otomatisasi proses: build, test, deployment aplikasi
• Menggunakan tools seperti: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions

3. Containerization dan Orchestration
• Mengelola aplikasi menggunakan container seperti: Docker
• Menggunakan orchestration tools seperti: Kubernetes, Docker Swarm

4. Monitoring dan Logging
• Memantau performa aplikasi dan server.
• Menggunakan tools seperti: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)

5. Automasi Infrastruktur
• Menggunakan Infrastructure as Code (IaC) untuk mengelola infrastruktur secara otomatis.
• Tools yang sering digunakan: Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi

6. Keamanan Sistem (Security)
• Mengelola security server dan aplikasi.
• Mengatur: firewall, access control, secrets management

7. Deployment Aplikasi
• Melakukan deployment aplikasi ke server atau cloud.
• Memastikan proses deployment berjalan tanpa downtime.

8. Kolaborasi dengan Tim Development

title: Data Engineer
job_description:
At VIDA we’re building the future of digital identity. As a Data Engineer you’ll work across the stack—from platform and infrastructure to data pipelines and end-user tooling. You’ll help us modernize our batch ETLs and lead our push into streaming and real-time fraud detection. We run on AWS and make extensive use of Scala Spark, dbt, and Terraform.Responsibilities


Build and expose the data lake/lakehouse so teams can understand business and product performance and make better decisions.

Design and evolve a data platform that enables scientists and analysts to query, model, and ship features and product metrics.

Develop scalable and reliable batch and streaming pipelines that ingest from varied sources and land trusted datasets.

Maintain and fix existing ETLs, improving reliability, observability, and cost while planning safe backfills and replays.

Model curated layers and maintain transformation logic (e.g., dbt), including testing, documentation, and data quality.

Build with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and contribute to CI/CD and deployment practices.

Partner with Engineering, and Data Science to deliver low-latency signals and features for real-time decisioning.

Contribute to internal tools, reusable components, and simple dashboards that unblock self-service.

Requirements


Solid engineering foundation with 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering and/or distributed systems.

Hands-on work building data pipelines (batch and/or streaming) using at least one distributed framework (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Flink).

Comfortable with SQL and a transformation framework (e.g., dbt or similar).

Familiarity with AWS services for data (any mix of S3, EMR/Glue, Kinesis/MSK, Lambda, Redshift/Athena) or equivalent cloud experience.

Exposure to workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow).

Experience using Terraform (or similar IaC) to manage data/platform resources.

Ownership mindset, focus on reliability, and enjoyment of collaborating in a fast-moving environment.

What are we trying to solve?


Billions of people still cannot securely prove their identity. Without it, they’re shut out of education, healthcare, finance, and civic participation. We believe this must change—and that digital identity should be trustworthy, private, and accessible to everyone.

At VIDA, we’re creating a frictionless digital identity system that meets the needs of our time and works anywhere, for everyone.

Why are we solving this problem?


Global initiatives like the UN and World Bank’s ID4D aim to provide legal identity for all by 2030. We expect digital identity to become a basic right, and we want VIDA to help lead that future.

Who are we?


We’re a mission-driven, pragmatic team motivated by real-world impact—from preventing fraud and corruption to unlocking fair access to essential services. If that resonates with you, we’d love to talk.

title: DevOps engineers

Job Description

Development and maintain the infrastructure: DevOps engineers are responsible for creating and managing the infrastructure needed to support software development and deployment. This includes designing, configuring, and maintaining servers, networks, storage, and other infrastructure components.
Automate processes: DevOps engineers use automation tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef to automate tasks like software deployment, configuration management, and testing. They also develop and maintain scripts and code to automate processes and tasks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams: DevOps engineers work closely with development, testing and support team to ensure that software applications are developed and deployed smoothly. They collaborate on code changes, help troubleshoot issues, and ensure that applications are deployed in a timely and efficient manner.
Implement and manage security policies: DevOps engineers are responsible for implementing and managing security policies and procedures to ensure the safety and integrity of the software applications and data. This include identifying potential security threats, implementing security measures, and monitoring for security breaches.
Continuously improve processes: DevOps engineers are always looking for ways to improve the software development and deployment process. They analyze performance metrics and other data to identify areas for improvement and work to implement changes that increase efficiency and reduce errors.
Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills: DevOps engineers should be able to troubleshoot issues quickly and effectively and have experience working with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, Splunk, or Dataog to identify and resolve problems.
Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related fields, or equivalent professional experience
Minimum 2 years’ experience with IT operations and infrastructure management and familiar with network and server administration, virtualization, cloud computing, and storage management.
Have a strong foundation and familiarity with operating systems like Linux or Windows.
Proficient in using automation tools like Ansible, Puppet or Chef, and have experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

title: AI Engineer
job_description:
Role: AI Engineer

Location: Jakarta
Position Type: Full-time
Reports to: CTO




About the Role

We are seeking an ML Engineer to own the AI and machine learning capability within an established cross-functional team. You will be the subject matter expert on LLMs, document AI, and RAG pipelines — working alongside experienced software developers, data engineers, and database engineers.

The role has a clear long-term roadmap: helping shape the logic of our document crawler, building ML pipelines that extract and populate structured databases, and ultimately delivering an internal chatbot grounded in our own ground-truth data. You will be joining a collaborative team where software developers, data engineers, and database architects will help support the surrounding infrastructure. The ideal candidate would combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in web crawling, document AI, RAG pipelines, and LLM tool integration — and is comfortable taking a system from prototype to production.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with the software development and data engineering teams on the company document crawler — contributing to crawler logic, defining document targeting requirements, and advising on ML-driven enhancements to improve discovery, classification, and retrieval of company documents (annual reports, regulatory filings, press releases).

Develop and fine-tune workflows combining SLMs (small language models), LLMs, and rule-based methods for accurate and explainable data extraction.

Architect and build the chatbot interface that grounds LLM responses in our structured databases and PDF corpus, using RAG and MCP-based tool calling to ensure answers are traceable to source data.

Integrate relevant open-source tools across the full stack: crawling (Scrapy, Playwright), document parsing (pdfplumber, Camelot, Tabula, Docling), ML/NLP (Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector stores (Qdrant, pgvector), and LLM serving (Ollama, vLLM) — selecting self-hosted vs. API-based options based on data sensitivity requirements.

Implement evaluation frameworks (accuracy, latency, cost) and maintain benchmarks for extraction quality.

Ensure robust engineering practices: testing, version control, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud deployment.

Contribute to research and stay up to date with advances in document AI, new libraries and new techniques.

Qualifications

Education: BSc (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

Experience: 3+ years of professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, or NLP Engineer.

Technical Skills (Required):

Demonstrated experience building tools that leverage LLMs/SLMs for text and document understanding.

Experience building web crawlers or scrapers (e.g. Scrapy, Playwright, BeautifulSoup) including handling rate limiting, dynamic content, and document deduplication

Strong programming skills in Python

Experience with document parsing libraries (pdfplumber, Camelot, Tabula, or Docling) and an understanding of the challenges of table extraction, multi-column layouts, and scanned documents

Hands-on use of vector databases (e.g., Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate) for retrieval-augmented generation.

Strong background in software engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD, testing)

Nice to Have:

Knowledge of financial or commodity reporting standards and typical document structures (annual reports, earnings releases, regulatory filings).

Experience deploying AI workloads in Microsoft Azure

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and building tool-calling integrations that connect LLMs to structured databases or document stores

Experience self-hosting LLMs locally using tools such as Ollama or vLLM, with an understanding of the trade-offs between local inference and cloud API usage

Familiarity with API design for ML deployment

Soft Skills

Ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders.

Excellent communication skills to explain AI model behaviour and limitations to non-technical teams.

What We Offer

Opportunity to build a greenfield AI product in the mineral economics domain.

Work with cutting-edge LLM and AI tools.

Modern, central office near to public transport and key amenities

Competitive salary

company: 深圳市基克纳科技有限公司
job_description:
Job Description for Factory IT Business Analyst (BA)




II. Core Job Responsibilities




1. Business Research and Pain Point Identification: Go deep into the factory's production workshops and warehouse frontlines, fully familiarize yourself with the entire warehouse process of "receiving, storing, issuing, counting, and managing" (including purchase warehousing, production material picking, production material returning, sales outbound, inventory counting, etc.) and the entire production process (production order maintenance, bill of materials management, production reporting, production warehousing, etc.). Sort out the existing business processes, job responsibilities and collaboration models, accurately identify business pain points, bottlenecks and optimization spaces, and form a business research and analysis report.




2. Requirements Analysis and Document Conversion: Combine the results of business research, collaborate efficiently with business departments such as production, warehousing and purchasing, collect, sort out and analyze business requirements. Convert complex business scenarios and operation processes into clear, standardized and implementable IT requirement documents, including but not limited to Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Requirements Document (FRD), flow charts, use case diagrams, etc. Ensure that the requirement description is accurate, the logic is clear, it is consistent with the actual business scenario of the factory, and bridge the cognitive gap between the IT development team and the business departments.




3. Project Implementation and Requirement Control: Participate in the entire process of requirement review, solution design, test verification and launch promotion of factory IT systems (such as MES, WMS, ERP production/warehousing modules, etc.), follow up the progress of requirement implementation throughout the process, coordinate and solve the connection problems between business and IT during the project implementation, ensure that the system functions meet the business requirements, and improve business operation efficiency.




4. Process Optimization and System Iteration: Continuously track the operation effect of production and warehousing business processes and IT systems, put forward requirement optimization suggestions based on business changes (such as capacity improvement, process adjustment) and system usage feedback, and promote the iterative upgrading of IT systems; assist business departments in sorting out standardized business processes, realize "process reengineering" based on "online processes", and help improve business efficiency.




III. Job Qualifications




(I) Hard Requirements




1. Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above, major in computer-related fields (Computer Science and Technology, Information Management and Information System, etc.), Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management and other related majors are preferred.




2. Work Experience: More than 3 years of relevant work experience as a factory IT Business Analyst (BA), must have business analysis experience related to factory warehouse management and production processes, be familiar with the entire process of factory production execution and warehouse management, and be able to independently complete business research, requirement analysis and requirement document writing.




3. Core Competencies: Possess strong requirement conversion ability, able to convert complex factory business scenarios (such as warehouse batch management, production material kitting analysis, inventory traceability, etc.) into standardized and implementable IT requirement documents; have clear logical thinking and problem analysis ability, able to quickly locate business pain points and put forward reasonable optimization solutions.




4. Successful Cases: At least 1 successful factory IT project case must be provided (which must include warehouse or production-related scenarios), clearly explaining the business analysis responsibilities undertaken in the project, the requirement conversion process and the project implementation results (such as quantifiable indicators such as process optimization efficiency, inventory accuracy improvement, energy consumption reduction, etc.), and the case must be true and traceable.

title: Maintenance Technician
job_description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Ag & Trading enterprise, where we connect producers and users of grains and oilseeds around the globe through origination, trading, processing, and distribution. We also offer a range of farmer services and risk management solutions. 

Job Purpose and Impact


The Maintenance Technician will perform maintenance, troubleshoot complex program issues as well as design, implement and modify program logic for computer-controlled systems with occasional guidance and assists others. In this role, you will utilize maintenance and reliability practices to ensure all assets are maintained in safe condition while continuing to ensure the life of the equipment.

Key Accountabilities


Design and implement logic controller programming and modify existing logic programming, as requested. Familiar with Siemens PCS7, Simatic manager, Tia Portal, CX Programmer.
Frequently assist in the design and installation of new or upgraded equipment and machinery (ex. conduit, wiring, power distribution, machine controls, machine automation, motors, counters, lighting and heat tracing).
Complete complex troubleshooting of machinery and automation failures including motor control devices, input sensing devices and other output devices.
Provide feedback and suggestions for improving the reliability of plant assets while troubleshooting machinery and automation failures as necessary.
Independently inspect and complete maintenance on packaging equipment, processing equipment, storage systems, plant utilities and other mechanical and electrical systems.
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications


Minimum Qualifications

Diploma's Degree (D3) Instrumentation & Control/Electro/Electronic
Familiar with PLC programming (Siemens PCS7, Simatic Manager, TIA Portal, CX Programmer), OPC, and Scada. Both design and troubleshooting on project scope.
Having knowledge on IT Devices and Networking both design and troubleshooting
Having knowledge on Process Instrumentation both design and troubleshooting
Having knowledge and capability on Instrumentation Calibration
Familiar with Maintenance Execution and Reporting
Other minimum qualifications may apply
Preferred Qualifications

Training certification of PLC, OPC, HMI
Experience in Automation and Instrumentation min: 5 years

title: Quality Engineer
job_description:
Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Perencanaan dan Persiapan Mutu (Pre-Construction)

Menyusun RMK (Rencana Mutu Kontrak): Membuat dokumen rencana mutu proyek (Project Quality Plan) yang mengacu pada Spesifikasi Umum Bina Marga

Pembuatan JMF & JMD: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembuatan Job Mix Design (JMD) dan Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Approval Material: Mengajukan persetujuan sumber material (Quarry) kepada Konsultan Pengawas dan Owner (Dinas PU/Balai). Mengingat di Jayapura, memastikan kualitas aggregate dari quarry lokal atau material didatangkan dari luar (misal: Palu/Sulawesi) sesuai spek sangat vital.

Kalibrasi Alat: Memastikan seluruh peralatan laboratorium dan peralatan batching plant atau AMP (Asphalt Mixing Plant) sudah terkalibrasi dan layak pakai.

2. Pengendalian Material Masuk (Incoming Material Control)

Inspeksi Bahan Baku: Melakukan pengecekan rutin terhadap material yang masuk ke stockpile (aspal cair, semen, agregat kasar/halus).

Uji Kualitas Rutin: Melakukan tes abrasi, kelekatan aspal, berat jenis, dan gradasi secara berkala untuk memastikan material dari quarry tetap konsisten.

3. Pengendalian Proses di Lapangan (Process Control)

Persetujuan Izin Kerja (Request for Work): Memverifikasi kesiapan lapangan sebelum pekerjaan dimulai (cek kebersihan, tack coat/prime coat, kesiapan alat).

Monitoring Suhu & Hamparan: Mengawasi suhu aspal saat di AMP, saat tiba di lokasi (dump truck), dan saat penghamparan (laying) agar sesuai JMF.

Pengawasan Pemadatan: Memastikan jumlah passing (lintasan) alat berat sesuai dengan trial section yang sudah disepakati.

Drainase & Bahu Jalan: Memastikan mutu beton untuk saluran drainase dan material timbunan bahu jalan sesuai spesifikasi.

4. Pengujian dan Laboratorium (Testing & Lab)

Manajemen Laboratorium: Memimpin teknisi lab dalam pelaksanaan tes harian.

Pengujian Lapangan: Mengawasi pelaksanaan Sand Cone Test (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan aspal), dan tes ekstraksi aspal (kadar aspal).

Trial Section: Memimpin pelaksanaan percobaan penghamparan (trial) sebelum pekerjaan utama dimulai.

5. Administrasi dan Pelaporan (Documentation)

Laporan Harian & Bulanan: Menyusun laporan Quality Control (QC) harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

Back-Up Data Quality: Menyusun kelengkapan data kualitas (hasil tes lab, foto dokumentasi, request) sebagai syarat penagihan termin (MC - Monthly Certificate).

Penanganan NCR (Non-Conformance Report): Jika ada pekerjaan yang tidak lulus tes (misal: aspal kurang tebal atau beton retak), QE wajib menganalisis penyebabnya dan mengusulkan metode perbaikan (corrective action) kepada Project Manager.




Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

Pendidikan: Minimal S1 Teknik Sipil, D3/D4 Sipil diperbolehkan jika memiliki pengalaman lapangan yang sangat kuat.

Sertifikasi Kompetensi (SKK/SKA): Wajib memiliki SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) Konstruksi yang masih aktif.

Jenjang: Minimal Ahli Muda (Jenjang 7) atau Ahli Madya (Jenjang 8).

Bidang: Teknik Jalan atau Ahli Material Jalan.

Pengalaman Minimal 3–5 tahun pengalaman kerja di posisi yang relevan (Quality Control/Quality Engineer).

Memiliki pengalaman spesifik pada proyek jalan aspal (Hotmix).

Diutamakan yang pernah menangani proyek Preservasi/Rehabilitasi Jalan

Mampu membuat dan menghitung Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Mampu mengoperasikan alat-alat laboratorium sipil dan memimpin teknisi lab.

Menguasai prosedur tes lapangan: Sand Cone (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan), Slump Test, ekstraksi aspal, dan Marshall Test.

Software: Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel (untuk laporan Back-Up Data Quantity & Quality) dan AutoCAD (untuk gambar kerja sederhana/sketsa titik kerusakan).

job_description:
About the Role

Olmero is Hubexo’s SaaS platform serving the Swiss construction industry. We’re building a new Jakarta-based team to work closely with our colleagues in Switzerland, and we’re looking for a Software Tester to be the first dedicated tester for Olmero in the hub.

Until now, most manual testing has been done directly by Product Owners. With the new team, we want someone who will take real ownership of testing: bringing structure to manual tests, helping reduce regressions, and gradually shaping how we approach test automation together with the engineers.

If you enjoy digging into web applications, thinking like a user, and quietly raising the quality bar every day, this might be a good place for you.




Key Responsibilities

Own and perform manual testing on Olmero’s test environment for new features and changes.

Review user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira, ask clarifying questions, and ensure they are clear and testable.

Design and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and checklists for functional, regression, and smoke testing.

Perform exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues.

Identify, document, and track defects clearly in Jira, and follow up with developers on resolutions.

Prepare and share concise test reports and release-readiness notes with the team.

Collaborate closely with developers, Product Owner, and Tech Leads (Switzerland and Jakarta) to understand flows, risks, and priorities.

Contribute to building a more structured testing and release process, including basic integration testing over time.

Gradually help the team identify high-value candidates for automation and support early automation initiatives where relevant.




Qualifications
Human Skills

Growth mindset: Demonstrated willingness to learn, adapt, and improve ways of working.

Empathy: Ability to understand user perspectives and the impact of defects on customers and teammates.

Communication: Clear verbal and written communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English; able to explain findings and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Team collaboration: Proven experience working in cross-functional teams (developers, POs, designers, etc.).

Ownership: Comfortable taking responsibility as the first dedicated tester on a product and following issues through to completion.

Adaptability: Able to work with evolving requirements and priorities in a distributed team setup.

Technical Skills

5+ years of experience as a Software Tester / QA Engineer, preferably on web-based SaaS products.

Strong experience in manual testing: functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing.

Ability to create clear, well-structured test cases and scenarios based on requirements and specifications.

Hands-on experience logging and managing defects using Jira (or similar issue tracking tools).

Exposure to test automation tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or similar.

Familiarity with testing against acceptance criteria and working closely with Product Managers.

Familiarity with Test Case Management tools such as AIO Tests, Qase, TestRail, or similar platforms.

Basic understanding of web technologies (HTTP, APIs, browsers, common failure modes).




Nice to Have

Basic proficiency with Git for source control.

Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.

Experience or interest in integration testing and end-to-end testing.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them.

Experience working with distributed teams across time zones.

Education and Experience

Experience in a SaaS environment or other complex, business-critical systems.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is also welcome.

Quantity Surveyor dan On-Site engineer bertanggung jawab untuk menghitung dan mengestimasi biaya proyek pembangunan, mulai dari material, tenaga kerja, hingga biaya lainnya. Posisi ini juga memastikan bahwa proyek berjalan sesuai dengan anggaran yang telah ditetapkan dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk mengoptimalkan biaya tanpa mengorbankan kualitas. Selain itu sebagai on-site engineer ditugaskan untuk mensupport kegiatan pembangunan proyek dari perihal teknis maupun non teknis.

Tanggung Jawab Utama:

Estimasi Biaya Proyek:

Menghitung dan menyiapkan estimasi biaya proyek pembangunan, termasuk material, tenaga kerja, dan biaya operasional.

Menganalisis gambar desain, spesifikasi teknis, dan dokumen proyek untuk menentukan kebutuhan biaya.

Pengadaan dan Penilaian Harga:

Mengumpulkan data dan mengevaluasi harga material dari vendor atau pemasok.

Membandingkan harga dan kualitas untuk memastikan biaya yang kompetitif.

Manajemen Anggaran:

Memantau dan mengontrol bahan yang dipakai oleh pekerja di lapangan selama proyek berjalan agar sesuai dengan anggaran yang telah disetujui.

Mengoptimalkan biaya pembangunan tanpa mengurangi kualitas proyek.

Pengukuran Kuantitas (Quantity Surveying):

Melakukan pengukuran kuantitas material dan pekerjaan yang dibutuhkan untuk proyek.

Menyiapkan Bill of Quantities (BoQ) atau Rencana Anggaran Biaya (RAB) yang detail.

Pelaporan dan Dokumentasi:

Menyiapkan laporan estimasi biaya, progress biaya, dan analisis variansi biaya.

Memastikan semua dokumen terkait biaya proyek terdokumentasi dengan baik.

Kegiatan di lapangan:

Mensupport dan mengatur tim yang berada di lapangan proyek.

Menyampaikan petunjuk teknis kepada seluruh tim pekerja.

Kualifikasi dan Keahlian:

Pendidikan: Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Sipil / Arsitektur

Pengalaman: Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Quantity Surveyor atau Estimator, terutama di industri konstruksi atau properti.

Keahlian:

Kemampuan analitis dan matematis yang kuat.

Pengetahuan tentang material, metode konstruksi, dan standar desain.

Menguasai software seperti Microsoft Excel.

Kemampuan komunikasi dan team-work yang baik.

Sifat Lain:

Detail-oriented dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

Memiliki integritas tinggi, kejujuran, dan kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik.

title: Microsoft Azure Integration & Container Specialist
job_description:
Trigyn has a contractual opportunity for a Azure Integration & Container Specialist (RIP Development). This resource will be working Remotely as per Philippines Times Zone.

Job Description:

The objectives of this assignment are to onboard a Microsoft Azure Integration and Container Specialist who focuses on designing, implementing, and managing cloud-based integration solutions and containerized applications for Client’s Integrated Disbursement System (IDS) modernization initiative. This role blends expertise in Azure services, containers, and integration technologies to enable scalable, secure, and efficient services.
To achieve this Client’s Right Integration Pattern will be used, this primarily consists of Microsoft APIM, Azure ServiceBus and Azure Container Apps. Additional integration software components include Azure Data Factory, temporal.io and Spring workflow.
The primary aim of this assignment is to develop and implement using the Right Integration Pattern (RIP) using Azure Container applications. This project is strategically important as it aims to leverage Azure’s scalable and reliable services to create a robust integration framework. The broader context of this project involves enhancing the efficiency and reliability of cloud-based applications using advanced Azure services.
Key focus areas include:
• Development of Azure Container Apps (ACA): Utilize ACA to maintain containerized applications and microservices in a highly scalable and cost-effective manner. This involves managing server configurations, clusters, and container orchestration using open-source technologies like Distributed Application Runtime (DApR), KEDA, and Envoy.
• Implementation of Azure Service Bus (ASB): Employ ASB to decouple applications and services, ensuring scalable and reliable communication through message queues and publish-subscribe topics. This will facilitate point-to-point communication and event-driven architecture, enhancing the overall system’s responsiveness and reliability.
• API Management: Use Azure API Management (APIM) to create, publish, secure, monitor, and analyze APIs. This will act as a gateway between backend services and API consumers, ensuring efficient management of the entire API lifecycle.
The significant achievements expected from this assignment include the successful deployment of a highly scalable and reliable integration pattern, improved resource management through Azure Resource Groups, and enhanced application performance and reliability through the use of ACA and ASB. There will be a focus on the development of common services using the RIP architecture.

Scope of Work/Responsibilities
1. The RIP Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing robust and scalable RIP (Right Integration Platform) solutions to support Client’s digital transformation initiatives. The consultant will work closely with the project team to understand requirements, develop technical specifications, and ensure the delivery of high-quality RIP systems. Key activities include:
2. Analyzing project requirements and translating them into technical specifications.
3. Designing and developing RIP software components and modules.
4. Conducting thorough testing and debugging of RIP systems to ensure functionality and performance.
5. Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate RIP solutions with existing systems.
6. Providing technical support and troubleshooting for RIP-related issues.
7. Documenting all development processes, code changes, and system configurations.
8. Ensuring compliance with Client’s standards and best practices in software development.
9. Training and mentoring junior developers on RIP technologies and methodologies.
10. The consultant is expected to deliver a fully functional RIP system that meets the project objectives, along with comprehensive documentation and support materials.
11. Detailed Tasks/Expected Output
12. Requirement Analysis and Planning:
13. Conduct a thorough analysis of the project requirements for developing RIP Azure container applications.
14. Design and Architecture:
15. Create detailed design documents that include the logical grouping of Azure services within the Azure Resource Group (RG) for particular projects or initiative.
16. Development and Configuration:
17. Develop and configure ACA to host containerized applications and microservices, ensuring the use of dapr for state management, service invocation, and event-driven architecture.
18. Implement KEDA for event-driven autoscaling of Kubernetes workloads.
19. Set up and configure ASB for message queues and publish-subscribe topics to ensure reliable and scalable communication between applications.
20. API Management:
21. Utilize Azure API Management (APIM) to create, publish, secure, monitor, and analyze APIs.
22. Ensure the APIs are well-documented and accessible to API consumers, providing a seamless integration with backend services.
23. Testing and Quality Assurance:
24. Conduct relevant testing of the developed applications and services to ensure they meet the specified requirements and performance standards.
25. Implement automated testing procedures to validate the functionality and reliability of the integration patterns.
26. Deployment and Monitoring:
27. Set-up infrastructure using Infra-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation).
28. Deploy the developed applications and services to the Azure platform, ensuring proper configuration and resource allocation within the Azure Resource Group.
29. Set up monitoring and logging mechanisms to track the performance and health of the applications and services (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).
30. Documentation and Training:
31. Prepare detailed documentation covering the design, development, configuration, and deployment processes.
32. Provide training sessions and support to the project team and stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition and effective use of the developed solutions.
33. Deliverables The individual shall deliver the following key outputs:
1) Contribute to project plan detailing timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
2) Detailed design documents and technical specifications for project implementation.
3) Develop and configure microservices and API related deliverables using RIP and other Client provided tool


Requirement and Qualification (Education & Work Experience)
The ideal candidate for the RIP Developer role must possess the following qualifications:
• Essential Skills and Experience:
o Proven experience in developing and deploying applications using Azure Container Apps (ACA) and Azure Service Bus (ASB).
o Strong understanding of serverless container services, microservices architecture, and event-driven architecture.
o Proficiency in using Distributed Application Runtime (dapr), Kubernetes-based Event Driven Autoscaling (KEDA), and Envoy.
o Demonstrated ability to manage resource provisioning, access controls, and cost management within Azure Resource Groups.
o Experience with API Management (APIM) for creating, publishing, securing, monitoring, and analyzing APIs.

• Educational Qualifications:
o A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.
o Desirable - Advanced certifications in Azure technologies, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, are highly desirable.

• Additional Experience:
o Experience with state management for stateful applications and services invocation to other microservices.
o Familiarity with message queues and publish-subscribe topics for scalable and reliable cloud-based applications.
o Knowledge of retry mechanisms and dead letter queues (DLQ) for message processing.

title: Engineer Industrial Applications
job_description:
Working Location : Site Based -  West Sumbawa
Working Schedule : Regular working days 4:2

The Engineer – Industrial Applications is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing engineering applications and tools used across fixed plant processing operations (crushing, grinding, flotation, thickening, filtration, utilities).

This role ensures that operational data, monitoring systems, reliability tools, and engineering applications are effectively used to maximize plant availability, improve equipment performance, and support maintenance and operations teams in continuous improvement.

The engineer acts as a key technical resource connecting Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, and Automation/Control Systems.

Some of your duties will include:

1. Engineering Applications & System Optimization

Maintain, improve, and support industrial applications used in fixed plant operations (e.g., CMMS, SCADA dashboards, condition‑monitoring tools).

Work closely with Operations to optimize process parameters and equipment performance.

Develop digital tools, dashboards, and workflows for improving decision‑making.

Support integration of sensors, analyzers, and process monitoring devices in plant circuits.

2. Data Analysis & Performance Improvement

Analyze plant performance data (throughput, downtime, recovery, equipment availability).

Identify operational bottlenecks across flotation, grinding, utilities, and filtration processes.

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on chronic equipment and process issues.

Recommend and implement improvement actions to increase overall plant efficiency (OEE).

3. Maintenance & Reliability Support

Collaborate with reliability teams to support predictive and preventive maintenance programs.

Analyze equipment data such as vibration, lubrication results, temperature trends, and instrumentation logs.

Use industrial engineering tools to improve equipment uptime and reduce breakdowns.

Validate and improve work order quality, spare parts usage, and maintenance documentation.

4. Project Engineering & Implementation

Lead or support plant improvement projects such as debottlenecking, capacity upgrades, instrumentation enhancements, and modernization of equipment.

Prepare engineering specifications, technical drawings, and project reports.

Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and contractors to ensure compliance with technical requirements.

Assist commissioning and start‑up of new systems and upgrades.

5. Safety, Compliance & Technical Governance

Ensure all engineering applications and improvement activities meet safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.

Participate in risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, and incident investigations.

Promote continuous improvement in safety culture through engineering solutions and automation.


What skills and experience do you need?
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Process/Metallurgical Engineering, or related field.

Experience

Minimum 3–5 years experience in mining or mineral processing (copper & gold preferred).

Experience working with fixed plant systems such as:

Crushing & Conveying

Grinding (SAG/Ball Mill)

Flotation Circuits

Thickening & Tailings

Filtration Plants

Water, Air & Reagent Utilities

Hands-on involvement with industrial systems, process monitoring, or reliability engineering.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of industrial equipment, plant processes, and operational workflows.

Skilled in using and optimizing:

CMMS (SAP, Pronto, Oracle)

SCADA / PLC / DCS visualization

Condition monitoring tools

Engineering software (AutoCAD, Power BI, Excel, etc.)

Ability to interpret P&IDs, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.

Experience in RCA, FMEA, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Ensure changes are traceable from requirement → spec → development → testing → production.

Deliver training and refreshers for FO, Finance, Retail, F&B, Sales & Marketing users.

Provide level‑1 functional support and escalate to in‑house dev/vendor where needed.




Data quality & reporting support

Database Architecture & Design : Design large-scale database architectures for both operational and analytical systems (OLTP & OLAP); Develop database schema blueprints, entity relationship models, indexing strategies, and partitioning approaches; Design data flows and replication topologies across systems (microservices, DWH, real-time pipelines); Define naming conventions, data modeling standards, and comprehensive documentation.

Performance & Scalability : Analyze and optimize query performance, indexing, and storage layers; Implement sharding, caching (Redis), and read replica strategies to achieve high scalability; Develop and monitor capacity planning and long-term data growth projections.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery : Design HA/DR systems using techniques such as streaming replication, failover clustering, and backup rotation; Define RTO/RPO targets in alignment with business SLAs; Conduct periodic disaster recovery tests to ensure system resilience.

Data Governance & Security : Implement data encryption, access control, and auditing policies; Ensure compliance with security standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS; Collaborate with the DevSecOps team to maintain data security and privacy.

Integration & Cloud Infrastructure : Design data integration across platforms (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.); Experienced in working with Cloud Platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure; Implement CDC pipelines and real-time synchronization across data systems.

Leadership & Collaboration : Provide technical direction to DBA, Data Engineer, and Developer teams; Collaborate with application and infrastructure architecture teams to design end-to-end systems; Develop database architecture documentation and best practice guidelines.


Requirement is :

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

Minimum 8+ years of experience in database design, development, and administration.

Proven experience in architecting large-scale and high-performance database systems (OLTP & OLAP).

Knowledge of data governance frameworks, data retention, and archival strategies.

Experience in implementing data encryption, access control, auditing, and compliance with standards such as GDPR, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.

title: Business Analyst

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and want to make a meaningful impact in the future of education.

Our purpose is to:

Empower institutions to guide their beneficiaries toward meaningful employment opportunities through AI-driven solutions

Demonstrate to the world that a global AI-powered B2B SaaS enterprise can be successfully built from Southeast Asia

About the Role
As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in designing and shaping end-to-end SaaS solutions for Kinobi’s clients. This role bridges business requirements and technical execution — ensuring proposed solutions are commercially viable, functionally clear, and technically feasible.
You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams across pre-sales and early delivery phases. While grounded in strong business analysis fundamentals, this role also involves contributing to high-level solution architecture and supporting technical solution decisions.
This position is ideal for candidates with Business Analyst, Pre-Sales, or Technical Consulting backgrounds who want to deepen their exposure to solution architecture in a SaaS environment.

Solution Architecture & Technical Ownership

Design and define high-level solution architectures, including system components, integrations, data flows, and deployment models.

Gather, analyze, and validate client business, functional, and technical requirements, including non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

Assess technical feasibility, risks, and constraints of proposed solutions, and recommend architectural approaches and mitigation strategies.

Act as the technical authority during pre-sales and solutioning, ensuring solutions align with product capabilities and implementation realities.

Functional Solutioning & Delivery Readiness

Translate solution architectures into clear functional scopes, assumptions, and constraints to support smooth handover from pre-sales to implementation

Guide proof-of-concepts (POCs) and demos, ensuring functional workflows and technical designs accurately reflect real-world use cases.

Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Implementation teams to ensure solutions are deliverable, scalable, and operationally sound.

Support audit and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, IMDA) by aligning solution designs with required security and regulatory standards.

Commercial & Operational Support

Support proposal development and RFP responses by contributing architectural inputs, functional solution narratives, and technical justifications.

Maintain clear and structured solution documentation to support internal alignment and execution.

Provide insights and feedback to improve solution effectiveness, proposal success, and client satisfaction.

Conduct structured follow-ups and engagements with potential clients to clarify business, functional, and technical requirements, validate solution assumptions, and refine solution scope throughout the pre-sales and solutioning process.

Requirements

1-3 years of experience in SaaS, solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical consulting, or solution-focused roles.

Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, system architecture concepts, and integration patterns.

Experience gathering and translating business, functional, and technical requirements into viable solution designs.

Ability to reason about non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

Comfortable balancing technical design with functional and operational considerations.

Strong English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Comfortable working closely with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Implementation).

Familiarity with AI-enabled solutions, data platforms, or process automation is a plus.

Exposure to RFPs, client-facing solutioning, or enterprise delivery environments preferred.

Work on a meaningful AI-powered product that’s transforming the future of education and impacting millions of students across Southeast Asia and beyond.

Kami mengundang talenta terbaik yang memiliki dedikasi, berpikiran terbuka (growth mindset) dan loyalitas untuk pengembangan karir dan pengembangan bisnis demi kemajuan bersama di masa depan. Kami tidak mencari sekadar analis data. Kami mencari “arsitek pertumbuhan”, seseorang yang mampu mengubah data menjadi strategi, dan strategi menjadi dampak nyata.  Kami mencari “problem solver berbasis data”, seseorang yang mampu melihat pola di balik angka, memahami bisnis secara mendalam, dan mengubah insight menjadi keputusan strategis.

Di peran ini, Anda akan berada di jantung pengambilan keputusan memahami apa yang benar-benar bekerja, apa yang tidak, dan ke mana kita harus melangkah berikutnya.

Tanggung Jawab (Job Description)

Turn Data Into Strategic Insight

Melakukan analisis data dan riset pasar untuk memahami tren industri, kebutuhan pelanggan, posisi kompetitif perusahaan serta peluang dan area yang perlu ditingkatkan dalam operasional bisnis.

Melakukan riset dan analisis mendalam (in-depth analysis) terhadap customer, marketing metrics, competitor landscape, serta tren marketing terbaru untuk mengidentifikasi peluang dan menutup gap pada produk maupun funnel.

Menggali data operasional, data pelanggan, data pasar untuk menemukan pola, peluang, dan risiko yang tidak terlihat oleh orang lain. 

Drive Decision-Making

Menyajikan insight yang tajam dan relevan untuk membantu manajemen mengambil keputusan berbasis data, bukan asumsi.

Bertanggung jawab atas fungsi analitik dengan merancang strategi pelacakan (tracking), membangun kerangka pengukuran (measurement framework), serta memberikan insight yang jelas terkait aktivitas operasional dan marketing.

Berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memberikan insight yang mendukung pengambilan keputusan strategis.

Solve Real Business Problems

Mengidentifikasi bottleneck, inefficiency, dan peluang growth dalam proses bisnis, lalu memberikan solusi yang actionable.

Mendukung pelaksanaan A/B testing dan desain eksperimen, memastikan setiap project dapat diukur dengan baik dan hasilnya valid secara statistik. 

Build Data-Driven System

Mengembangkan dashboard, model analitik, dan framework pengukuran yang menjadi fondasi pengambilan keputusan perusahaan.

Collaborate Across Functions

Bekerja lintas tim (Operations, Marketing, Finance, Product) untuk memastikan setiap strategi didukung oleh data yang solid.

Kualifikasi (Requirements)

Pendidikan minimal Diploma/Sarjana di bidang terkait (relevan).

Memiliki pengalaman bekerja minimal 1 s.d. 5 tahun dibidang data analyst dan business analyst (lebih diutamakan yang menguasai market research dan marketing analysis).

Mampu berpikir kritis dan sistematis serta mampu menghubungkan data dengan konteks bisnis.

Pengalaman dalam menggunakan alat analisis data (Google Analytics, Power BI, SQL, Python dan tools sejenisnya), termasuk kemampuan mengolah big data secara efisien.

Berpengalaman membuat dashboard menggunakan tools visualisasi data (Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI atau sejenisnya).

Memahami berbagai channel digital marketing (iklan berbayar, SEO, referral, pertumbuhan organik, kampanye CRM).

Memahami statistik, analisis tren, dan machine learning dasar.

Kemampuan untuk bekerja dengan data besar dan kompleks. 

Berpikir analitis, detail-oriented, serta mampu menyajikan data secara logis.

Komunikatif & kolaboratif, bisa bekerja sama dengan tim marketing, sales, dan operasional.

Lancar berbahasa Inggris.

Kompensani dan Benefit

Gaji dan tunjangan yang kompetitif dengan insentif (bonus) kinerja.

BPJS (Asuransi kesehatan).

Exposure langsung ke decision-making level.

Lingkungan kerja yang mendorong thinking, ownership, dan impact.

Kesempatan berkembang menjadi future leader di bidang data, business & strategy.

title: Associate Product Manager - Subs Growth and Lifecycle
job_description:
The Economist Group is the leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs. We deliver world-class, thought-provoking content through a range of formats, from web and app to print, conferences, film, and audio. What ties us together is the objectivity of our opinion, the originality of our insight, and our advocacy of economic and political freedom around the world.

As our digital subscription business grows, so does the importance of delivering thoughtful, frictionless, and value-driven experiences across the entire subscriber lifecycle.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated Associate Product Manager to join our Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle product pillar. In this role, you will support the continuous improvement of subscription journeys that maximise subscriber lifetime value and foster long-term loyalty across web and app.

This is a hands-on role with strong exposure to strategy and delivery. You will contribute to initiatives across retention, upgrades, and customer care, working closely with experienced product managers, engineers, analysts, marketers, and customer operations teams. It offers a valuable opportunity to develop deep expertise in subscription products, monetisation, and experimentation within a globally recognised media organisation.

What you’ll do

As the Associate Product Manager for Subscriber Growth & Lifecycle, you will be responsible for the following with support from more senior Product Managers:

Own and optimise the end-to-end subscriber journey: You will be the product manager for key in-life subscription experiences, including upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and re-engagement flows. You will continuously identify and address friction points, and champion a subscriber-first mindset in everything you do.

Drive monetisation and experimentation: You will develop and execute a roadmap of monetisation initiatives, including offers, add-ons, and subscription tiers. You will design and run experiments to optimise our upgrade and retention paywalls, and use data to inform our pricing and packaging strategies.

Innovate in customer care: You will partner with our Customer Care teams to redefine how we serve our subscribers. You will lead the development of our self-service and assisted service journeys, including implementing AI-powered bots and other automation technologies to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Champion a data-driven culture: You will define and analyse key metrics such as churn, upgrades, engagement, and customer satisfaction. You will use this data to measure the impact of your initiatives, identify new opportunities, and communicate your progress to stakeholders.

Lead with influence: You will write clear and compelling user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. You will use your strong communication and collaboration skills to align your team and stakeholders around a shared vision and roadmap.

What you’ll bring

We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about building great products and eager to learn and grow. The ideal candidate will have:

A proven track record of driving results: You have at least 2 years of experience in product management or a similar role (such as Product Marketing or Product Analytics) with a focus on digital customer journeys. You can point to specific examples of how you have used offers, discounts, add-ons, or subscription tiers to achieve business goals.

A deep understanding of the subscriber lifecycle: You have experience with paywall campaigns, experiments, or launches across web and app. You are familiar with the key levers for driving subscriber engagement, retention, and lifetime value.

A strategic and analytical mindset: You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities. You have a structured, data-informed approach to problem-solving and prioritisation. You are proficient in using data to make decisions and measure success.

Exceptional collaboration and communication skills: You are a natural collaborator who can work effectively with designers, engineers, analysts, and operational teams. You can articulate your ideas clearly and persuasively, and you are a great listener.

A "go-getter" mindset with high autonomy: You are a self-starter who takes initiative and can run with things independently. While you will have support from senior PMs, you are comfortable taking the lead on projects, navigating ambiguity, and proactively pushing initiatives to completion.

Nice to have:

Experience managing monetisation for a B2C app and web product.

Exposure to monetisation automation, personalisation, or machine-learning-driven decisioning.

Familiarity with subscription platforms or lifecycle marketing tools (e.g., Zuora, SF).

Experience with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g., Amplitude, Tableau, SQL).

Why this role matters

This is an opportunity to make a real impact on The Economist's future. By improving our in-life subscription experience, you will not only drive revenue growth but also help us build a more sustainable and resilient business. You will be at the heart of our efforts to create a lifelong relationship with our readers and to ensure that The Economist remains the world's leading source of analysis on international business and world affairs for generations to come.

Location:

This role is based in South East Asia.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of escalation for all Odoo-related issues. You need to deeply understand how standard business processes (Sales, Inventory, Accounting, etc.) map to Odoo's functionalities. Your main objective is to assist in troubleshooting Odoo's issues from issue documentation and identification, help analyze and assist in resolving user inquiries at first hand, investigate data anomalies, and ensure business continuity without always relying on the core development team. Furthermore, you will act as the primary owner for scoping, exploring, and managing any new technical functionalities or third-party integrations (such as AI agents or Claude AI) to expand and enhance the Odoo ecosystem.

1. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting:

- Act as the Level 1 technical and functional support for all Odoo ERP users across departments.

- Read and analyze system logs or error tracebacks to determine if an issue is a user error, a configuration issue, or a technical bug.




2. Business Process & Functional Support:

- Guide and educate end-users on the correct way to utilize Odoo features according to the company's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Assist user in performing data corrections and adjustments within Odoo safely (e.g., fixing stuck inventory moves, correcting journal entries).

3. Technical support Escalation & Collaboration:

- Assist in testing bug fixes and patches deployed by developers in a staging environment before they are released to production.




4. System Enhancement & New Integrations:

- Act as the primary owner and project lead for any new technical functionalities to be built or integrated with Odoo.

- Research, scope, and manage third-party integrations, including exploring emerging technologies like AI agents (e.g., Claude AI integration).

- Bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution for system expansions, ensuring new integrations align with existing Odoo architecture.

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience providing application support or working as a Functional Consultant specifically for Odoo ERP.

- Strong understanding of core Odoo modules (e.g., Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.

- Ability to quickly understand diverse business workflows and translate user complaints into systemic Odoo functions.

- Ability to read and understand Python error logs and tracebacks.

- Forward-thinking mindset with an eagerness to explore and implement new technologies (such as AI tools) into existing ERP workflows.

- Project management mindset with the ability to take ownership of new system features from exploration to deployment.

Responsible for supporting the implementation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework through the collection, analysis, validation, and reporting of risk data across all company units.

This role focuses on the development of the risk reporting system, management of the risk register, preparation of Key Risk Indicators (KRI), and strengthening of risk governance in accordance with regulatory requirements (Bank Indonesia) and internal company policies. The position plays a role in maintaining the integrity of risk data, ensuring the effectiveness of internal controls, and supporting risk-based decision making.

What Will You Do: 

Collect, validate, and analyze risk data across business and operations, including trend analysis, loss events, incident reports, and control effectiveness using quantitative and qualitative methods.

Develop and maintain data-driven risk dashboards and reports to monitor KRI, EWI, and risk appetite metrics, and present insights to ERM Manager, Risk Committee, and regulators.

Maintain and update the company’s risk governance documentation, including risk registers, control libraries, committee minutes, action items, and follow-up tracking to ensure alignment with internal risk policies.

Support Risk Management Committee activities and regulatory governance by preparing complete, accurate quarterly and annual risk reports while enforcing compliance with internal risk documentation standards.

Support enterprise-wide risk identification and assessment while coordinating mitigation actions with relevant units to ensure timely completion of risk treatment plans.

About Wego


We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world.

The Marketing Technology team sits at the intersection of Performance Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering.

We focus on building scalable tracking frameworks, attribution models, automation pipelines, and AI-powered systems that drive measurable growth. The team enables marketing to operate with precision — turning raw campaign data into actionable insights and automation that improves ROI across all channels.

The Role


As a Marketing Data Analyst within the Marketing Technology team, you will play a critical role in shaping how we measure, optimize, and scale our digital marketing performance.

You will combine advanced analytics, attribution modeling, SQL-driven deep dives, and AI-powered automation to unlock growth opportunities across multiple advertising platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of data, experimentation, and digital advertising innovation.

What You Will Be Working On


Generating actionable insights from large-scale marketing campaign datasets

Designing and maintaining in-house attribution models across complex customer journeys

Leveraging AI and LLM-based workflows to scale personalized ad content generation

Detecting and mitigating digital ad fraud

Building dashboards and reporting frameworks that inform executive-level decisions

Partnering closely with Performance Marketing to drive measurable revenue impact

Core Responsibilities


Partner with the Performance Marketing team to deliver personalized, data-driven content and oversee tracking and measurement across multiple advertising platforms

Analyze campaign performance data to surface optimization opportunities that drive measurable growth

Leverage AI and LLM-based models to automate generation of ad copy, images, and video at scale

Design, implement, and maintain attribution models that evaluate touchpoints across the full customer journey

Monitor and detect digital ad fraud and deploy proactive countermeasures, including tools such as AppsFlyer Protect360

Build and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks to visualize key performance metrics

Conduct in-depth data analysis using SQL to identify trends and inform strategic marketing decisions

Collaborate cross-functionally with Data, Product, and Engineering to ensure data integrity and alignment

Skills and Experience


3+ years of experience in digital marketing analytics or a related field

Advanced SQL proficiency with 3+ years of hands-on experience

Intermediate Python skills with practical application in analytics workflows

Proven experience using LLMs to generate marketing content at scale

Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies and attribution modeling

Experience with digital ad fraud detection and MMP tools such as AppsFlyer Protect360

Working knowledge of major advertising platforms including Meta, Google, Apple Search Ads, TikTok, Snapchat, and X

Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Looker or Tableau

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives

High attention to detail and commitment to data quality

What Success Looks Like


Clear attribution visibility across paid channels

Measurable uplift in campaign efficiency driven by data-led recommendations

Scalable AI-powered content workflows implemented

Reduced fraud impact across paid channels

Stakeholders relying on your dashboards and insights to guide investment decisions

Why Join Wego


You’ll be joining a global team that moves fast, thinks analytically, and builds for scale.

We encourage smart work within work hours, invest in professional development, support wellness, and offer travel benefits so you can experience the product you help grow. You’ll collaborate across markets and time zones, gaining exposure to a truly international digital business.

If you’re excited about combining analytics, AI, and marketing performance to drive real growth, we’d love to hear from you.

1. Melakukan need assessment terhadap individu, sekolah, perguruan tinggi, maupun perusahaan untuk mengidentifikasi gap kompetensi, potensi, dan tantangan organisasi.

• Training soft skill (Leadership, Communication, Achievement Motivation,
Team Building, dll.)
• Program pengembangan manajerial
• Coaching & Counseling for Leader
• Asesmen psikologis (bakat, minat, kepribadian, rekrutmen, promosi jabatan)
• Program pengembangan karier untuk pelajar/mahasiswa
5. Menyusun proposal program yang komprehensif dan solutif sesuai kebutuhan klien.
6. Menyesuaikan modul, metode pembelajaran, dan alat asesmen agar sesuai dengan karakteristik audiens.
7. Berkoordinasi dengan tim trainer/asesor untuk memastikan program berjalan sesuai desain intervensi.
8. Melakukan evaluasi efektivitas program dan memberikan rekomendasi tindak lanjut berbasis data.

B. Business Development & Marketing Responsibilities
1. Mengidentifikasi peluang pasar baru di sektor akademis, lembaga profit (BUMN & swasta) atau non-profit (komunitas, organisasi), dan lembaga pemerintahan.

6. Mengelola pipeline penjualan dari prospek hingga closing.
7. Menyusun penawaran harga dan melakukan negosiasi kerja sama.
8. Bekerja sama dengan tim digital marketing untuk:
• Penyusunan konten promosi
• Campaign awareness
• Lead generation

10. Mencapai target penjualan dan pertumbuhan bisnis yang telah ditetapkan.
11. Membuat laporan perkembangan bisnis dan analisis performa penjualan.
12. Mengembangkan strategi retensi klien dan repeat order.

Pendidikan & Latar Belakang
• Minimal D4 atau S1 semua jurusan.

• Mampu melakukan presentasi profesional kepada klien.
• Terbiasa menggunakan tools seperti Microsoft Office/Google Workspace (terutama Word, Excel, dan PowerPoint)
• Memahami strategi dasar digital marketing dan proses akuisisi pelanggan baru menjadi nilai tambah.

Policy & Process Improvement: Collaborate with team leads to review and enhance risk policies, standard operating procedures, and internal controls to ensure they remain robust and scalable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with STLs, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure risk considerations are integrated into new product launches and features.

What You Will Need:

Educational Background: Fresh graduate or recent graduate (graduated within the last 2 years) with a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputable university.
Field of Study: Strong academic track record in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or other related quantitative fields.
Data Proficiency: Analytical skills with hands-on experience in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Python, or R) is highly preferred.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Logical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a passion for data analysis and tackling complex challenges.

About Luxehouze

Luxehouze is a fast-growing omnichannel luxury marketplace operating across Indonesia and Singapore, serving high-value customers in watches, fashion, and beauty. We operate in an environment where trust, speed and excellence matter, and where outcomes matter more than activity.

Take ownership without being askedThey step in when something breaks and follow through until it’s resolved
